title: KIara verstehen: Ingestion und Retrieval

state.description: Geprüfter Arbeitsbaum einschließlich vorhandener uncommittierter Research-, Retrieval- und Chat-Änderungen. Kein Release- oder Laufzeitnachweis.

legend.call: Durchgezogen → Aufruf oder vom benannten Orchestrator ausgeführter Ablauf. Der Beleg nennt den tatsächlichen Caller.
legend.data: Gestrichelt ⇢ Datenfluss oder Speicherzugriff. Kein zusätzlicher Funktionsaufruf behauptet.
legend.job: Dick ⇒ Hintergrundauftrag über persistente Queue und Prozessgrenze.
legend.optional: Violett / „optional“: nur bei erfüllter Konfiguration. Gelbe Raute: Entscheidung. Rot: Fehler. Alle Pfade hier sind am Code geprüft, keiner als Laufzeitbeobachtung markiert.

glossary.Chunk: Ein indexierter Textabschnitt mit Quelle, Position, Parser und Metadaten.
glossary.Embedding: Numerische Darstellung eines Textes für Ähnlichkeitssuche; das Modell/Profil definiert den Vektorraum.
glossary.RRF: Reciprocal Rank Fusion: verbindet Ranglisten durch Beiträge aus der jeweiligen Rangposition.
glossary.Reranking: Nachträgliche Relevanzbewertung von Frage und Kandidat; liegt außerhalb des HybridRetrievers.
glossary.DDU / VLM: DDU extrahiert Dokumentstruktur über Remote-Docling. VLM beschreibt Bilder als zusätzlich indexierbaren Text.
glossary.Late Chunking / ColBERT: Late Chunking berechnet Abschnittsvektoren mit Volltextkontext. ColBERT speichert zusätzliche Tokenvektoren für MaxSim.
glossary.Freigabe: Bestätigter dokumentweiter Zustand: vollständige Darstellung, gespeicherte Version und gemeinsamer PG-Dateiabschluss.
glossary.DS / Scope: Datenquelle / für diese Anfrage wirksame Menge erlaubter Quellen.

caveats: Ungeprüft: Welche optionalen Pfade eine konkrete produktive Datenquelle oder Anfrage tatsächlich durchläuft. Die Karten beschreiben Codebedingungen, keine ausgelesene Produktivkonfiguration.
Ungeprüft: End-to-End-Verhalten bei realen DDU-/Embedding-/ES-Ausfällen und konkreten Dokumenten. Dafür sind die Beispielabläufe in #416 vorgesehen.
Aus dem Code geprüft: Ein OTel-Span kann auch bei deaktiviertem Teilverfahren entstehen. enabled/configured/attempted und Trefferzahl müssen gemeinsam gelesen werden.

Bewusste Grenze: Spezialfälle der HTML-/Mailmigration, ERP-/Aktionswerkzeuge, Rewriter und Unchained sind nur als Abgrenzung erfasst. Unchained umgeht den RAG-Pfad; die Karten fokussieren Standard, Agent, Research und direkte Suche.
findings: Im gemeinsamen Retrieverpfad verhindern quellenweiter Publikationszustand und Versionsprüfungen die Nutzung unvollständiger Versionen. Ein Qdrant-Schreiberfolg ist noch kein Dateiabschluss. Die abweichende Prüfung im Such-Tab ist separat dokumentiert.
Resume: _load_and_diff_files ignoriert Erfolgslogs als Abschlussnachweis. Die vorhandene alte Hilfsfunktion _filter_resumed_files wird auf diesem Pfad nicht aufgerufen.

DDU: Loader-Kommentare suggerieren teilweise Standard-Fallback; _load_content verwirft Ergebnisse mit ddu_error timeout/connection/http_error tatsächlich auch bei Text. Das Diagramm folgt dem ausgeführten Code.
Graph-Extraktion heißt im Docstring asynchron, wird aber per asyncio.run bzw. Future.result abgewartet. Sie ist kein unabhängiger Hintergrundauftrag.
Hybrid-Suchpfade laufen nacheinander. Reranking, Query-Expansion und Sibling-Expansion sind aufruferspezifisch und keine universellen Retriever-Stufen.
Job-Erfolg und fehlerfreie Dateien sind verschieden: _resolve_job_outcome kann ohne abort_reason trotz Dateifehlern finalisieren. HTML-/Mailmigration behandelt Dateifehler strenger.
Es gibt keine verteilte Transaktion über Qdrant, ES und PG. Freigaben, Versionsprüfung, Rollback und dauerhaftes Cleanup-Inventar bilden den geprüften Konsistenzmechanismus.

Such-Tab-Ausnahme: /api/search verwendet direkte ES-/Qdrant-Suche. Nur der Textzweig hat hier eine zusätzliche aktuelle PG-Owner-/Publikationsprüfung. Im semantischen Zweig fehlt sie im gelesenen Code. Statischer Befund; kein Laufzeitvorfall reproduziert, funktionale Korrektur außerhalb dieses Dokumentationsmeilensteins.

tracing.spans: ingest_file → load_content, chunk_and_collect, embed_batch → write_vectors, write_elasticsearch, graph_extraction
tracing.gap: Unveränderte Dateien kommen nicht in die Dateischleife und haben keinen ingest_file-Span. Queue/Scan/Hashdiff und finaler PG-Commit sind keine durchgängige eigene Span-Kette.

tracing.spans: hybrid_retrieve → semantic_retrieve, keyword_retrieve, graph_retrieve, colbert_retrieve, rrf_fusion
tracing.gap: Im reinen Semantikzweig fehlen die separaten Teilspans. Aktivierungs-/Versuchsattribute beachten; ein Span allein belegt keine ausgeführte Suche.

tracing.spans: rag_query → query_expansion, sibling_expansion, context_build, llm_setup; rerank separat instrumentiert
tracing.gap: llm_setup misst Generator-Erstellung, nicht Tokenstreamdauer. query_log ergänzt End-to-End-Zeit; Context-Override überspringt Suche.

tracing.spans: agent_query → agent_iteration → llm_step / tool_call: …; forced_search, loop_detection, final_answer
tracing.gap: final_answer markiert Entscheidung; seine Dauer ist nicht die Streamingdauer. Tool-Threads propagieren OTel-Kontext ausdrücklich.

tracing.spans: Gemeinsame Retrieval-/Rerankspans; Research run_id und strukturierte Such-/Leselogs, direkter Service correlation_id/Diagnostik
tracing.gap: Kein eigener vollständiger Research-Rootspan in der geprüften ResearchChain. run_id/correlation_id sind nicht automatisch OTel-trace_id.

tracing.spans: tracing.enabled, tracing.pipelines, Export postgresql/otlp/both; vorhandener Admin-Tab System → Traces
tracing.gap: Bei deaktiviertem oder fehlgeschlagenem Tracing NoOp. Vorhandene Instrumentierung wurde statisch geprüft; keine konkrete Trace-ID als Beispiel übernommen.

tracing.spans: Eigene query_time_ms in /api/search; kein Aufruf von hybrid_retrieve
tracing.gap: Keine gemeinsame Hybrid-Span-Kette für diese Route. Den semantischen Such-Tab nicht mit dem geprüften Retriever-Ausgabevertrag gleichsetzen.

def enqueue_job(
    ds_id: int,
    job_type: str = "incremental",
    triggered_by: str = "manual",
    *,
    embedding_model: str,
    html_migration: dict | None = None,
    html_reingest: str | None = None,
) -> int:
    """Erstellt einen neuen Job in der Queue.

    embedding_model ist keyword-only ohne Default — fehlende Aufrufe
    scheitern am Funktionsaufruf (TypeError) statt erst zur Laufzeit.

    Raises:
        TypeError: Wenn embedding_model nicht uebergeben wird (Python-nativ).
        ValueError: Wenn embedding_model leer ist oder ein Job bereits existiert.
    """
    from kiara.backend_selector import normalize_model_name
    from kiara.config import load_config
    from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import (
        IndexOperation,
        guard_index,
        primary_index_target,
        raw_qdrant_client,
    )

    embedding_model = normalize_model_name(embedding_model)
    initial_stats = {}
    if html_reingest is not None:
        from kiara.ingestion.html_reingest import build_request, validate_target

        if job_type != "incremental" or html_migration is not None:
            raise ValueError("HTML-Modus braucht einen eigenen inkrementellen Job")
        initial_stats["html_reingest"] = build_request(html_reingest)
        with db_query() as db:
            ds = db.execute("SELECT * FROM datasources WHERE id = %s", (ds_id,)).fetchone()
            if not ds:
                raise ValueError(f"Datenquelle {ds_id} fehlt")
            validate_target(dict(ds), embedding_model)
            stock = db.execute(
                "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM file_hashes WHERE datasource_id = %s AND embedding_model = %s) "
                "OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chunk_datasources WHERE datasource_id = %s AND embedding_model = %s) AS present",
                (ds_id, embedding_model, ds_id, embedding_model),
            ).fetchone()
            if not stock["present"]:
                raise ValueError("Kein bestehender Bestand fuer das gewaehlte Modell")
    if html_migration is not None:
        if job_type != "incremental":
            raise ValueError("Migrationsjobs muessen incremental bleiben")
        initial_stats["html_migration"] = validate_selection(html_migration, ds_id, embedding_model)
    if not embedding_model:
        raise ValueError(
            f"DS {ds_id}: Kein Embedding-Modell angegeben. "
            "Jeder Ingestion-Job muss ein Embedding-Modell spezifizieren."
        )

    config = load_config()
    target = primary_index_target(config, embedding_model)
    with guard_index(
        config,
        target,
        operation=IndexOperation.JOB_ENQUEUE,
        write=True,
        allow_initialize=html_reingest is None,
        qdrant_client=raw_qdrant_client(config),
    ) as contract_token:
        contract = contract_token.job_fields()
        db = contract_token.connection
        db.execute(
            "SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s, %s)",
            (INGESTION_DATASOURCE_LOCK_NAMESPACE, ds_id),
        )
        ds_row = db.execute(
            "SELECT id, is_active FROM datasources WHERE id = %s FOR UPDATE",
            (ds_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if not ds_row:
            raise ValueError(f"DS {ds_id}: Datenquelle nicht gefunden")
        if not ds_row["is_active"]:
            raise ValueError(f"DS {ds_id}: Datenquelle ist deaktiviert")

        status_placeholders = ", ".join(["%s"] * len(_ACTIVE_JOB_STATUSES))
        existing = db.execute(
            "SELECT id FROM ingestion_jobs WHERE datasource_id = %s "
            f"AND status IN ({status_placeholders}) "
            "ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE",
            (ds_id, *_ACTIVE_JOB_STATUSES),
        ).fetchone()
        if existing:
            raise ValueError(f"DS {ds_id} hat bereits einen aktiven Job (#{existing['id']})")
        job_id = insert_returning(
            db,
            "INSERT INTO ingestion_jobs (datasource_id, job_type, triggered_by, "
            "embedding_model, stats_json, queued_at, contract_logical_index_key, "
            "contract_index_compatibility_id, contract_query_compatibility_id, "
            "contract_canonical_model_id, contract_profile_id, contract_profile_kind, "
            "contract_profile_endpoint, contract_snapshot_sha256, contract_fence_version) "
            "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, NOW(), %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s)",
            (
                ds_id,
                job_type,
                triggered_by,
                embedding_model,
                json.dumps(initial_stats, ensure_ascii=False),
                contract["contract_logical_index_key"],
                contract["contract_index_compatibility_id"],
                contract["contract_query_compatibility_id"],
                contract["contract_canonical_model_id"],
                contract["contract_profile_id"],
                contract["contract_profile_kind"],
                contract["contract_profile_endpoint"],
                contract["contract_snapshot_sha256"],
                contract["contract_fence_version"],
            ),
        )

    logger.info(
        "Job #%s enqueued (DS %s, %s, model=%s, by %s)",
        job_id,
        ds_id,
        job_type,
        embedding_model,
        triggered_by,
    )

    # Admin-UI-Caches aktualisieren
    from kiara.web.cache_refresh import refresh_datasource_cache, refresh_jobs_cache

    safe_refresh(refresh_jobs_cache, job_id)
    safe_refresh(refresh_datasource_cache, ds_id)

    return job_id

def _fetch_next_job(self):
        """Holt den naechsten pending Job und claimt ihn atomar."""
        from kiara.config import load_config
        from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import (
            IndexCompatibilityError,
            IndexContractUnavailableError,
            IndexOperation,
            guard_job_contract,
            validate_job_contract_snapshot,
        )

        with db_query() as db:
            candidate = db.execute(
                "SELECT j.* FROM ingestion_jobs j "
                "JOIN datasources d ON d.id = j.datasource_id "
                "WHERE j.status = 'pending' AND d.is_active = true "
                "ORDER BY j.queued_at ASC, j.id ASC LIMIT 1"
            ).fetchone()
        if not candidate:
            return None
        candidate = dict(candidate)
        config = load_config()
        try:
            with guard_job_contract(
                config,
                candidate,
                operation=IndexOperation.JOB_CLAIM,
                write=True,
                allow_initialize=True,
            ) as token:
                db = token.connection
                row = db.execute(
                    "SELECT j.* FROM ingestion_jobs j "
                    "JOIN datasources d ON d.id = j.datasource_id "
                    "WHERE j.id = %s AND j.status = 'pending' AND d.is_active = true "
                    "FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED",
                    (candidate["id"],),
                ).fetchone()
                if not row:
                    return None
                current = dict(row)
                validate_job_contract_snapshot(
                    current,
                    token,
                    operation=IndexOperation.JOB_CLAIM,
                )
                db.execute(
                    "UPDATE ingestion_jobs SET status = 'initializing', started_at = NOW() "
                    "WHERE id = %s",
                    (candidate["id"],),
                )
                current["status"] = IngestionStatus.INITIALIZING.value
                return current
        except IndexContractUnavailableError as exc:
            # Reine Index-Abhaengigkeitsstoerung ist kein Vertragsbruch.
            # Der Job bleibt pending und wird vom naechsten Poll erneut
            # atomar geclaimt; kein semantischer Providerkontakt findet statt.
            logger.warning(
                "Job %s wartet pending auf Index-Abhaengigkeit: %s",
                candidate["id"],
                exc.detail,
            )
            return None
        except IndexCompatibilityError as exc:
            logger.error(
                "Job %s am Contract-Claim blockiert: %s",
                candidate["id"],
                exc,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            with db_transaction() as db:
                db.execute(
                    "UPDATE ingestion_jobs SET status = %s, finished_at = NOW(), "
                    "error_message = %s, stats_json = COALESCE(stats_json, '{}'::jsonb) || %s::jsonb "
                    "WHERE id = %s AND status = %s",
                    (
                        IngestionStatus.ERROR.value,
                        str(exc),
                        json.dumps(exc.to_dict(), ensure_ascii=False),
                        candidate["id"],
                        IngestionStatus.PENDING.value,
                    ),
                )
            return None

worker.code:
def _execute_job(self, row):
        """Fuehrt einen einzelnen Ingestion-Job aus (Orchestrator).

        Delegiert an Phasen-Methoden; haelt nur noch den aeusseren
        try/except/finally und die Ablauf-Entscheidungen.
        """
        job_id = row["id"]
        ds_id = row["datasource_id"]
        job_type = row["job_type"]
        embedding_model = row["embedding_model"] or None

        with self._lock:
            self._current_job_id = job_id
            self._processing_tid = threading.get_native_id()

        start_time = time.time()
        _check_control = self._build_check_control(job_id)
        config = None  # fuer except-Block (locals-Fallback)
        stats = None

        try:
            if not embedding_model:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Job #{job_id} hat kein Embedding-Modell. "
                    "Jeder Ingestion-Job muss ein Embedding-Modell spezifizieren. "
                    "Dieser Job wurde vermutlich vor der Multi-Embedding-Aenderung erstellt."
                )
            # Phase 1: Job-Kontext laden (DS, Config, Connector)
            ctx = self._load_job_context(row, ds_id, job_id)
            config = ctx["config"]
            from kiara.web.cache_refresh import IngestionCacheRefresh

            self._progress_cache = IngestionCacheRefresh(
                ds_id,
                job_id,
                interval=config.get("ingestion", {}).get("admin_cache_refresh_seconds", 3),
            )
            connector_cls = ctx["connector_cls"]
            conn_config = ctx["conn_config"]
            ds_row = ctx["ds_row"]
            tracker = getattr(self, "_activity_tracker", None)
            if tracker is not None:
                tracker.begin_job(job_id, ds_id, ds_row["type"])

            from kiara.ingestion.runtime import _wait_for_index_contract_target_recovery
            from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexContractUnavailableError

            contract_start_stats: dict[str, int] = {}
            stats = contract_start_stats
            while True:
                try:
                    marked_running = self._mark_job_running(row, config)
                    break
                except IndexContractUnavailableError as exc:
                    recovered = _wait_for_index_contract_target_recovery(
                        config,
                        exc,
                        control_callback=_check_control,
                        status_callback=lambda phase: self._set_job_phase(job_id, phase),
                        stats=contract_start_stats,
                    )
                    if recovered:
                        continue
                    signal = _check_control()
                    if signal == "cancel":
                        self._finalize_cancelled(job_id, ds_id, contract_start_stats)
                    return

            if not marked_running:
                logger.info(
                    "Job %s wurde vor dem Running-Status abgebrochen oder veraendert",
                    job_id,
                )
                return

            # Phase 2: Callbacks aufbauen
            callbacks = self._build_callbacks(job_id, ds_id)
            _on_progress = callbacks["on_progress"]

            # Phase 3: Backend-Warmup
            warmup_stats_dict = self._run_warmup(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                ds_row,
                embedding_model,
                config,
                start_time,
                _check_control,
            )
            if warmup_stats_dict is None:
                return  # Warmup fehlgeschlagen oder abgebrochen

            # Phase 4: Scan (parallel oder sequentiell)
            scan_info = self._run_scan_phase(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                job_type,
                config,
                connector_cls,
                conn_config,
                ds_row,
                _on_progress,
                _check_control,
                embedding_model=embedding_model,
            )
            if scan_info is None:
                return  # Abgebrochen oder fehlgeschlagen waehrend Scan

            # Phase 5: Full-Reingest-Cleanup (falls noetig)
            if job_type == "full":
                self._prepare_full_reingest(job_id, ds_id, config, embedding_model)

            # Phase 6: Resume-Skip ermitteln
            resume_skip_files = self._load_resume_skip_files(
                job_id,
                row["resumed_from_job"],
                job_type,
            )

            # Phase 7: Ingestion ausfuehren (Pass 1)
            overrides = build_datasource_overrides(ds_row) or None
            hash_mode = getattr(connector_cls, "HASH_MODE", "mtime")

            stats, flush_fn = self._run_ingestion(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                job_type,
                config,
                overrides,
                embedding_model,
                _on_progress,
                _check_control,
                callbacks,
                resume_skip_files,
                hash_mode,
                warmup_stats_dict,
            )
            for key in (
                "contract_discovery_waits",
                "contract_discovery_recoveries",
                "contract_discovery_wait_seconds",
            ):
                stats[key] = stats.get(key, 0) + contract_start_stats.get(key, 0)

            # Phase 8: Parallel-Scan Pass 2 (falls noetig)
            if scan_info.get("scan_thread") is not None:
                self._run_pass2(
                    job_id,
                    ds_id,
                    config,
                    overrides,
                    embedding_model,
                    _on_progress,
                    _check_control,
                    callbacks,
                    hash_mode,
                    warmup_stats_dict,
                    stats,
                    flush_fn,
                    scan_info,
                )

            # Phase 9: Ergebnis auswerten und finalisieren
            duration = int(time.time() - start_time)
            stats["duration_seconds"] = duration
            self._resolve_job_outcome(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                config,
                embedding_model,
                stats,
                duration,
                _check_control,
            )

        except Exception as exc:
            # Shutdown-Check auch bei unerwarteten Exceptions.
            try:
                self._close_progress_cache()
            except Exception as cache_exc:
                logger.warning("Cache-Abschluss fehlgeschlagen: %s", cache_exc, exc_info=True)
            if self._stop.is_set():
                logger.info("Job %s: Shutdown waehrend Fehler — wird auto-resumed", job_id)
                return
            from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexCompatibilityError

            error_message = str(exc)
            secondary_errors = getattr(exc, "ingestion_secondary_errors", ())
            if secondary_errors:
                stats = dict(stats or {})
                stats.setdefault("error_details", []).extend(secondary_errors)
            if isinstance(exc, IndexCompatibilityError):
                diagnostic = exc.to_dict()
                stats = dict(stats or {})
                if stats.get("index_compatibility_error") != diagnostic:
                    stats["errors"] = stats.get("errors", 0) + 1
                    stats.setdefault("error_details", []).append(
                        {
                            "phase": "index_compatibility",
                            "reason_code": exc.reason_code,
                            "operation": exc.operation,
                            "consumer": "ingestion_worker",
                            "diagnostic": diagnostic,
                        }
                    )
                stats["index_compatibility_error"] = diagnostic
                stats["abort_reason"] = (
                    f"Index-Kompatibilitaetsguard: {exc.reason_code} ({exc.detail})"
                )
                error_message = stats["abort_reason"]
            # Worker-Fail-Closed: Job auf FAILED, naechster Job kann laufen.
            # exc_info=True liefert den Traceback fuer Audit, ohne den Loop
            # zu brechen.
            logger.error(
                "Job %s (DS %s): unerwarteter Fehler — Job wird auf FAILED gesetzt: %s",
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                error_message,
                exc_info=True,
            )
            duration = int(time.time() - start_time)
            self._finalize_error(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                error_message,
                duration,
                config=config,
                embedding_model=embedding_model,
                stats=stats,
            )

        finally:
            try:
                self._close_progress_cache()
            finally:
                tracker = getattr(self, "_activity_tracker", None)
                if tracker is not None:
                    tracker.finish_job(job_id)
                with self._lock:
                    self._current_job_id = None
                    self._processing_tid = None

scan.code:
def _run_scan_phase(
        self,
        job_id,
        ds_id,
        job_type,
        config,
        connector_cls,
        conn_config,
        ds_row,
        on_progress,
        check_control,
        *,
        embedding_model=None,
    ):
        """Fuehrt die Scan-Phase durch (parallel oder sequentiell).

        Setzt config["datasource"]["path"] als Seiteneffekt.

        Returns:
            dict mit keys: scan_thread, scan_complete, scan_error
            None bei Cancel/Shutdown/Fehler waehrend sequentiellem Scan.
        """
        if config.get("_html_reingest") is not None:
            if job_type != "incremental":
                raise ValueError("HTML-Neuaufbereitung darf keinen Voll-Cleanup starten")
            return self._run_html_reingest_phase(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                config,
                connector_cls,
                conn_config,
                ds_row,
                on_progress,
                check_control,
                embedding_model,
            )
        migration = validate_run_selection(config, ds_id, embedding_model)
        if migration is not None:
            self._set_job_phase(job_id, "HTML-/Mailbestand aufbereiten...")
            # Nur die lokale/IMAP-Vorbereitung unter der vorhandenen DS-Sperre
            # halten. Vor Pipeline-Indexfences wird sie wieder freigegeben.
            with db_transaction() as db:
                db.execute(
                    "SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s, %s)",
                    (INGESTION_DATASOURCE_LOCK_NAMESPACE, ds_id),
                )
                prepared = prepare_migration_files(
                    config,
                    connector_cls,
                    conn_config,
                    dict(ds_row),
                    embedding_model,
                    on_progress,
                    check_control,
                )
                _update_job_stats(db, job_id, html_migration_errors=prepared["errors"])
            signal = check_control()
            if signal == "shutdown":
                return None  # Running-Auswahl bleibt fuer Auto-Resume erhalten.
            if prepared["cancelled"] or signal == "cancel":
                self._finalize_cancelled(
                    job_id,
                    ds_id,
                    {
                        "phase": "migration_prepare",
                        "html_migration": selection_spec(migration),
                    },
                )
                return None
            return {"scan_thread": None, "scan_complete": None, "scan_error": [None]}

        cache_path = connector_cls.effective_path(conn_config, dict(ds_row))
        _use_parallel = (
            job_type != "full"
            and getattr(connector_cls, "SUPPORTS_PARALLEL_SCAN", False)
            and os.path.isdir(cache_path)
            and any(True for e in os.scandir(cache_path) if e.is_file() or e.is_dir())
        )

        if _use_parallel:
            return self._start_parallel_scan(
                job_id,
                config,
                connector_cls,
                conn_config,
                ds_row,
                cache_path,
                check_control,
            )

        # Sequentiell: wie bisher
        self._set_job_phase(job_id, "Synchronisierung...")
        path = connector_cls.prepare_and_scan(
            conn_config,
            dict(ds_row),
            config,
            progress_callback=on_progress,
            control_callback=check_control,
        )
        if check_control() in ("cancel", "shutdown"):
            self._finalize_cancelled(job_id, ds_id, {"phase": "scan"})
            return None
        if path is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Vorbereitung fehlgeschlagen fuer Typ {ds_row['type']}")
        config["datasource"]["path"] = path
        return {"scan_thread": None, "scan_complete": None, "scan_error": [None]}

parallel.code:
def _start_parallel_scan(
        self, job_id, config, connector_cls, conn_config, ds_row, cache_path, check_control
    ):
        """Startet einen Parallel-Scan im Hintergrund.

        Returns:
            dict mit keys: scan_thread, scan_complete, scan_error
        """
        scan_error = [None]
        scan_complete = threading.Event()

        def _on_scan_progress(processed, total):
            try:
                with db_transaction() as _db:
                    _update_job_stats(_db, job_id, scan_processed=processed, scan_total=total)
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.debug("Job %s: Scan-Progress-Update fehlgeschlagen: %s", job_id, exc)

        def _background_scan():
            try:
                path = connector_cls.prepare_and_scan(
                    conn_config,
                    dict(ds_row),
                    config,
                    progress_callback=_on_scan_progress,
                    control_callback=check_control,
                )
                if path is None and check_control() not in ("cancel", "shutdown"):
                    scan_error[0] = RuntimeError(
                        f"Scan fuer DS {ds_row['id']} lieferte keinen Cache-Pfad"
                    )
            except Exception as exc:
                scan_error[0] = exc
                logger.error("Background-Scan fehlgeschlagen: %s", exc, exc_info=True)
            finally:
                scan_complete.set()

        # Scan-Cache invalidieren (sonst skip wegen .scan_done).
        # Nur sinnvoll fuer Konnektoren mit aktivem Scan-Cache; Parallel-Scan
        # ist heute auf IMAP/Exchange beschraenkt, der defensive Guard
        # vermeidet Permission-Errors falls das jemals erweitert wird.
        if getattr(connector_cls, "SCAN_CACHE_MAX_AGE", 0) > 0:
            _marker = os.path.join(cache_path, ".scan_done")
            try:
                os.remove(_marker)
            except FileNotFoundError:
                pass
            except OSError as exc:
                logger.warning(
                    "Job %s: Scan-Cache-Marker %s konnte nicht entfernt werden: %s",
                    job_id,
                    _marker,
                    exc,
                )

        scan_thread = threading.Thread(
            target=_background_scan,
            daemon=True,
            name="bg-scan",
        )
        scan_thread.start()
        self._set_job_phase(job_id, "Synchronisierung + Verarbeitung...")
        logger.info("Job %s: Parallel-Scan gestartet, Ingestion auf Cache", job_id)

        config["datasource"]["path"] = cache_path
        return {
            "scan_thread": scan_thread,
            "scan_complete": scan_complete,
            "scan_error": scan_error,
        }

pass2.code:
def _run_pass2(
        self,
        job_id,
        ds_id,
        config,
        overrides,
        embedding_model,
        on_progress,
        check_control,
        callbacks,
        hash_mode,
        warmup_stats_dict,
        stats,
        flush_fn,
        scan_info,
    ):
        """Fuehrt Pass 2 nach Parallel-Scan durch (neue Dateien verarbeiten).

        Mutiert *stats* in-place (fuehrt Pass-2-Stats zusammen).
        """
        from kiara.ingestion.pipeline import run_ingestion, set_current_job_id

        scan_thread = scan_info["scan_thread"]
        scan_complete = scan_info["scan_complete"]
        scan_error = scan_info["scan_error"]

        # Scan-Thread joinen (warte bis Download fertig)
        if not scan_complete.is_set():
            self._set_job_phase(job_id, "Warte auf Synchronisierung...")
            logger.info("Job %s: Pass 1 fertig, warte auf Scan...", job_id)

        while not scan_complete.is_set():
            scan_complete.wait(timeout=2.0)
            if check_control() in ("cancel", "shutdown"):
                break
        scan_thread.join(timeout=10)

        # Scan-Progress entfernen (scan fertig)
        try:
            with db_transaction() as _db:
                _update_job_stats(_db, job_id, scan_processed=None, scan_total=None)
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.debug("Job %s: Scan-Progress-Reset fehlgeschlagen: %s", job_id, exc)

        # Pass 2 nur wenn: kein Cancel, kein Scan-Fehler, kein Abort
        if (
            not stats.get("abort_reason")
            and check_control() not in ("cancel", "shutdown")
            and not scan_error[0]
        ):
            self._set_job_phase(job_id, "Verarbeite neue Dateien...")
            logger.info("Job %s: Starte Pass 2 (neue Dateien)", job_id)

            set_current_job_id(job_id)
            try:
                stats_p2 = run_ingestion(
                    config,
                    incremental=True,
                    datasource_id=ds_id,
                    ds_overrides=overrides,
                    progress_callback=on_progress,
                    control_callback=check_control,
                    embedding_model=embedding_model,
                    file_log_callback=callbacks["on_file_log"],
                    file_start_callback=callbacks["on_file_start"],
                    resume_skip_files=None,
                    hash_mode=hash_mode,
                    status_callback=callbacks["on_status"],
                    activity_callback=callbacks.get("on_activity"),
                    warmup_stats=warmup_stats_dict,
                )
            finally:
                set_current_job_id(None)
            flush_fn()

            # Stats zusammenfuehren
            for key in (
                "processed_files",
                "total_chunks",
                "errors",
                "deleted_files",
                "dedup_chunks",
                "ddu_files",
                "ddu_remote_files",
                "ddu_remote_errors",
                "ddu_timeout",
                "vlm_chunks",
                "vlm_errors",
                "graph_entities",
                "graph_relations",
                "graph_errors",
                "vectordb_errors",
                "vectordb_recoveries",
                "contract_discovery_waits",
                "contract_discovery_recoveries",
                "contract_discovery_wait_seconds",
            ):
                if key in stats_p2:
                    stats[key] = stats.get(key, 0) + stats_p2[key]
            stats["total_files"] = stats_p2.get("total_files", stats.get("total_files", 0))
            stats["skipped_files"] = stats_p2.get("skipped_files", stats.get("skipped_files", 0))
            if stats_p2.get("abort_reason"):
                stats["abort_reason"] = stats_p2["abort_reason"]
            if stats_p2.get("index_compatibility_error"):
                stats["index_compatibility_error"] = stats_p2["index_compatibility_error"]
            if stats_p2.get("index_compatibility_rollback_errors"):
                stats["index_compatibility_rollback_errors"] = stats_p2[
                    "index_compatibility_rollback_errors"
                ]
            if stats_p2.get("error_details"):
                stats.setdefault("error_details", [])
                stats["error_details"].extend(stats_p2["error_details"])
            stats["parallel_scan"] = True
            stats["pass2_new_files"] = stats_p2.get("processed_files", 0)
            logger.info(
                "Job %s: Pass 2 fertig — %d neue Dateien",
                job_id,
                stats_p2.get("processed_files", 0),
            )
        elif scan_error[0]:
            logger.warning(
                "Job %s: Scan fehlgeschlagen: %s — Pass-1-Ergebnisse bleiben", job_id, scan_error[0]
            )
            stats["abort_reason"] = f"Parallel-Scan fehlgeschlagen: {scan_error[0]}"
            stats["parallel_scan"] = True

worker_run.code:
def _run_ingestion(
        self,
        job_id,
        ds_id,
        job_type,
        config,
        overrides,
        embedding_model,
        on_progress,
        check_control,
        callbacks,
        resume_skip_files,
        hash_mode,
        warmup_stats_dict,
    ):
        """Fuehrt run_ingestion() aus (Pass 1).

        Returns:
            tuple (stats_dict, flush_fn) — flush_fn muss nach Pass 2 erneut
            aufgerufen werden koennen.
        """
        from kiara.ingestion.pipeline import run_ingestion, set_current_job_id

        self._set_job_phase(job_id, "Hashing...")

        incremental = job_type != "full"
        migration = validate_run_selection(config, ds_id, embedding_model)
        if migration is not None:
            resume_skip_files = None  # Ganze Auswahl erneut; keine Teilschritt-Recovery.
        set_current_job_id(job_id)
        try:
            stats = run_ingestion(
                config,
                incremental=incremental,
                datasource_id=ds_id,
                ds_overrides=overrides,
                progress_callback=on_progress,
                control_callback=check_control,
                embedding_model=embedding_model,
                file_log_callback=callbacks["on_file_log"],
                file_start_callback=callbacks["on_file_start"],
                resume_skip_files=resume_skip_files,
                hash_mode=hash_mode,
                status_callback=callbacks["on_status"],
                activity_callback=callbacks.get("on_activity"),
                warmup_stats=warmup_stats_dict,
            )
        finally:
            set_current_job_id(None)

        if migration is not None:
            from kiara_ingestion_core.models import FileLogEntry

            stats["html_migration"] = selection_spec(migration)
            if config.get("_html_reingest") is not None:
                stats["html_reingest"] = config["_html_reingest"]
                stats["html_reingest_summary"] = config["_html_reingest_summary"]
            stats["html_migration_errors"] = migration["errors"]
            stats["errors"] = stats.get("errors", 0) + len(migration["errors"])
            for path, error in migration["errors"].items():
                callbacks["on_file_log"](
                    FileLogEntry(
                        file_path=path,
                        file_name=os.path.basename(path),
                        file_size=0,
                        file_ext=os.path.splitext(path)[1],
                        status="error",
                        error_message=error,
                        error_phase="migration_prepare",
                    )
                )
            expected = set(migration["files_by_model"][embedding_model])
            if set(stats.get("html_migration_completed_paths", [])) != expected:
                stats["abort_reason"] = "Migrationsauswahl nicht vollstaendig verarbeitet"

        # Rest-Buffer flushen
        callbacks["flush_file_logs"]()
        return stats, callbacks["flush_file_logs"]

outcome.code:
def _resolve_job_outcome(
        self, job_id, ds_id, config, embedding_model, stats, duration, check_control
    ):
        """Entscheidet ueber Success/Error/Cancel/Shutdown und finalisiert."""
        # --- Shutdown-Check (VOR Finalize) ---
        if self._stop.is_set():
            # Graceful Shutdown: Job NICHT finalisieren.
            # Bleibt als 'running' in DB → _recover_stale_jobs() auto-resumed.
            logger.info("Job %s: Shutdown — wird beim naechsten Start fortgesetzt", job_id)
            return

        # Race-Window: Wenn SIGTERM zwischen self._stop.is_set() (oben) und
        # _check_control() eintrifft, gibt _check_control() "shutdown" zurueck.
        signal = check_control()
        if signal == "shutdown":
            logger.info("Job %s: Shutdown (late) — wird beim naechsten Start fortgesetzt", job_id)
            return
        if stats.get("html_migration") and stats.get("errors") and not stats.get("abort_reason"):
            stats["abort_reason"] = "Dateifehler bei HTML-/Mailmigration"
        if signal == "cancel":
            self._finalize_cancelled(job_id, ds_id, stats)
        elif stats.get("abort_reason"):
            self._finalize_error(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                stats["abort_reason"],
                duration,
                config=config,
                embedding_model=embedding_model,
                stats=stats,
            )
        else:
            self._finalize_success(job_id, ds_id, stats, config, embedding_model)

finalize.code:
def _finalize_success(self, job_id, ds_id, stats, config, embedding_model):
        """Job erfolgreich abgeschlossen (Orchestrator).

        Delegiert an:
        - _aggregate_final_stats(): VektorDB-Stats sammeln
        - _update_datasource_metadata(): DB-Updates fuer Job + Datasource
        - _log_job_completion(): Logging, Cache-Invalidierung, Cron-Drift-Check
        """
        self._close_progress_cache()
        chunk_count, finished = self._aggregate_final_stats(
            stats,
            config,
            ds_id,
            embedding_model,
        )

        with db_transaction() as db:
            self._update_datasource_metadata(
                db,
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                stats,
                config,
                embedding_model,
                chunk_count,
                finished,
            )

        self._log_job_completion(
            job_id,
            ds_id,
            stats,
            embedding_model,
        )

control.code:
def _build_check_control(self, job_id):
        """Erzeugt die Control-Callback-Closure (Cancel/Pause/Resume/Shutdown).

        Gibt eine Funktion zurueck, die None | 'cancel' | 'shutdown' liefert.
        Bei 'pause' blockiert sie bis Resume oder Cancel.
        """

        def _check_control():
            # Shutdown-Check ZUERST — vor DB-Read, damit SIGTERM
            # sofort wirkt und nicht erst auf DB-Antwort wartet.
            if self._stop.is_set():
                return "shutdown"
            try:
                # Nur lesen, nicht sperren: Der Callback wird auch innerhalb
                # des Index-Contract-Guards aufgerufen. Dieser haelt den
                # ingestion_jobs-Datensatz bereits per FOR UPDATE. Ein
                # weiterer FOR-UPDATE-Read ueber eine zweite Verbindung
                # wuerde deshalb bis zum statement_timeout auf den eigenen
                # Worker warten. Pause/Cancel-Writer serialisieren ihre
                # Updates weiterhin in ihren eigenen Transaktionen.
                with db_query() as db:
                    ctrl_row = db.execute(
                        "SELECT requested_action FROM ingestion_jobs WHERE id = %s",
                        (job_id,),
                    ).fetchone()
                    action = ctrl_row["requested_action"] if ctrl_row else None
            except Exception:
                # DB-Fehler → Job laeuft weiter; Audit-Spur fuer Diagnose.
                logger.debug(
                    "Job %s: Control-Poll DB-Fehler — Job laeuft weiter",
                    job_id,
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                return None
            if action == "cancel":
                return "cancel"
            pause_poll_interval = 1.0
            while action == "pause":
                if self._stop.is_set():
                    return "shutdown"
                if self._stop.wait(pause_poll_interval):
                    return "shutdown"
                # Schrittweise erhoehen: 1s, 1s, 2s, 2s, 3s, ... bis max 5s
                if pause_poll_interval < 5.0:
                    pause_poll_interval = min(pause_poll_interval + 0.5, 5.0)
                try:
                    with db_query() as db:
                        ctrl_row = db.execute(
                            "SELECT requested_action FROM ingestion_jobs WHERE id = %s",
                            (job_id,),
                        ).fetchone()
                        action = ctrl_row["requested_action"] if ctrl_row else None
                except Exception:
                    # Bei DB-Fehler waehrend Pause NICHT entpausieren.
                    logger.debug(
                        "Job %s: Pause-Poll DB-Fehler — bleibe pausiert",
                        job_id,
                        exc_info=True,
                    )
                    continue
                if action == "cancel":
                    return "cancel"
                if action != "pause":
                    break  # Resume oder NULL → weiter
            return None

        return _check_control

recover.code:
def _recover_single_job(self, _unused_db, srow, *, manual_html_retry=False):
        """Versucht einen einzelnen stale Job per Auto-Resume neu einzureihen.

        Prueft Cancel-Request, Embedding-Modell-Verfuegbarkeit und ob bereits
        ein Pending-Job fuer die Datasource existiert. Erstellt bei Bedarf
        einen neuen incremental Job.

        Args:
            _unused_db: Historischer Signaturplatzhalter; S4 nutzt die vom
                Contract-Guard gefencete Transaktion.
            srow: Row-Dict des stale Jobs (id, datasource_id, embedding_model,
                  requested_action, job_type).

        Returns:
            bool: True wenn ein Resume-Job erstellt wurde, False sonst.
        """
        old_job_id = srow["id"]
        ds_id = srow["datasource_id"]
        emb_model = srow["embedding_model"] or ""

        # V29-FIX: Cancel-Request respektieren
        if not manual_html_retry and srow["requested_action"] == "cancel":
            logger.info(
                "DS %s: Stale Job #%s hatte Cancel-Request — kein Auto-Resume",
                ds_id,
                old_job_id,
            )
            return False

        if not manual_html_retry and srow["requested_action"] == "pause":
            logger.info(
                "DS %s: Stale Job #%s hatte Pause-Request — kein Auto-Resume",
                ds_id,
                old_job_id,
            )
            return False

        if not emb_model:
            logger.warning(
                "DS %s: Stale Job #%s hat kein Embedding-Modell — "
                "markiere als error (kein Auto-Resume moeglich)",
                ds_id,
                old_job_id,
            )
            return False

        # Normalisierung fuer Altdaten
        from kiara.backend_selector import normalize_model_name

        emb_model = normalize_model_name(emb_model)
        if not emb_model:
            logger.warning(
                "DS %s: Stale Job #%s hat nach Normalisierung kein Embedding-Modell — "
                "markiere als error",
                ds_id,
                old_job_id,
            )
            return False

        from kiara.config import load_config
        from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import (
            IndexCompatibilityError,
            IndexOperation,
            guard_job_contract,
            validate_job_contract_snapshot,
        )

        try:
            # Auch eine Wiederholung bleibt ein Bestandsauftrag. Eine fehlende
            # Collection darf nicht als erlaubter Erstaufbau behandelt werden.
            with db_query() as read_db:
                retry_row = read_db.execute(
                    "SELECT stats_json FROM ingestion_jobs WHERE id = %s", (old_job_id,)
                ).fetchone()
            html_retry = bool(request_fields(retry_row["stats_json"])) if retry_row else False
            with guard_job_contract(
                load_config(),
                dict(srow),
                operation=IndexOperation.JOB_ENQUEUE,
                write=True,
                allow_initialize=not html_retry,
                validation_scope="stored_binding",
            ) as token:
                db = token.connection
                locked_old = db.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM ingestion_jobs WHERE id = %s FOR UPDATE",
                    (old_job_id,),
                ).fetchone()
                if not locked_old:
                    return False
                validate_job_contract_snapshot(
                    dict(locked_old),
                    token,
                    operation=IndexOperation.JOB_ENQUEUE,
                )
                if not manual_html_retry and locked_old.get("requested_action") in (
                    "cancel",
                    "pause",
                ):
                    return False
                # Gleiche Lock-Reihenfolge wie enqueue_job(): Contract zuerst,
                # danach Datasource.
                db.execute(
                    "SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(%s, %s)",
                    (INGESTION_DATASOURCE_LOCK_NAMESPACE, ds_id),
                )
                statuses = (
                    _ACTIVE_JOB_STATUSES if manual_html_retry else (IngestionStatus.PENDING.value,)
                )
                existing = db.execute(
                    "SELECT id FROM ingestion_jobs WHERE datasource_id = %s AND status = ANY(%s)",
                    (ds_id, list(statuses)),
                ).fetchone()
                if existing:
                    if manual_html_retry:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Datenquelle hat bereits einen aktiven Job (#{existing['id']})"
                        )
                    logger.warning(
                        "DS %s: Pending Job #%s existiert bereits — kein Auto-Resume",
                        ds_id,
                        existing["id"],
                    )
                    return False

                orig_job_type = srow.get("job_type") or "incremental"
                migration = selection_from_stats(locked_old.get("stats_json"), ds_id, emb_model)
                html_fields = request_fields(locked_old.get("stats_json"))
                if manual_html_retry:
                    from kiara.ingestion.html_reingest import validate_request, validate_target

                    if not html_fields or locked_old["status"] not in {"error", "cancelled"}:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Nur fehlgeschlagene oder abgebrochene HTML-Jobs sind wiederholbar"
                        )
                    validate_request(html_fields["html_reingest"], check_current=True)
                    ds = db.execute(
                        "SELECT * FROM datasources WHERE id = %s FOR UPDATE", (ds_id,)
                    ).fetchone()
                    if not ds or not ds["is_active"]:
                        raise ValueError("Datenquelle fehlt oder ist deaktiviert")
                    validate_target(dict(ds), emb_model)
                if (migration is not None or html_fields) and orig_job_type != "incremental":
                    raise ValueError("Migrationsjobs muessen incremental bleiben")
                resume_stats = json.dumps(
                    {
                        "resumed_from_job": old_job_id,
                        **html_fields,
                        **({"html_migration": migration} if migration is not None else {}),
                    },
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                )
                contract = token.job_fields()
                new_job = db.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO ingestion_jobs "
                    "(datasource_id, job_type, triggered_by, embedding_model, stats_json, "
                    "resumed_from_job, queued_at, contract_logical_index_key, "
                    "contract_index_compatibility_id, contract_query_compatibility_id, "
                    "contract_canonical_model_id, contract_profile_id, contract_profile_kind, "
                    "contract_profile_endpoint, contract_snapshot_sha256, contract_fence_version) "
                    "VALUES (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, NOW(), %s, %s, %s, %s, "
                    "%s, %s, %s, %s, %s) RETURNING id",
                    (
                        ds_id,
                        orig_job_type,
                        "manual" if manual_html_retry else "auto-resume",
                        emb_model,
                        resume_stats,
                        old_job_id,
                        contract["contract_logical_index_key"],
                        contract["contract_index_compatibility_id"],
                        contract["contract_query_compatibility_id"],
                        contract["contract_canonical_model_id"],
                        contract["contract_profile_id"],
                        contract["contract_profile_kind"],
                        contract["contract_profile_endpoint"],
                        contract["contract_snapshot_sha256"],
                        contract["contract_fence_version"],
                    ),
                )
                return new_job.fetchone()["id"] if manual_html_retry else True
        except IndexCompatibilityError as exc:
            if manual_html_retry:
                raise ValueError(f"HTML-Wiederholung am Vertragsguard blockiert: {exc}") from exc
            logger.error(
                "DS %s: Auto-Resume von Job #%s am Contract-Guard blockiert: %s",
                ds_id,
                old_job_id,
                exc,
            )
            return False

warmup.code:
def _run_warmup(
        self, job_id, ds_id, ds_row, embedding_model, config, start_time, check_control
    ):
        """Fuehrt Backend-Warmup durch.

        Returns:
            warmup_stats_dict bei Erfolg, None bei Fehler/Abbruch
            (Fehler-/Cancel-Finalisierung wird intern erledigt).
        """
        from kiara.backend_warmup import BackendWarmer, build_warmup_tasks
        from kiara.shared.constants import WARMUP_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT

        self._set_job_phase(job_id, "Backend-Warmup...")

        try:
            warmup_tasks = build_warmup_tasks(ds_row, embedding_model, config)
        except RuntimeError as exc:
            duration = int(time.time() - start_time)
            self._finalize_error(job_id, ds_id, str(exc), duration)
            return None

        warmup_result = BackendWarmer().warm(
            warmup_tasks,
            timeout=WARMUP_TIMEOUT_DEFAULT,
            check_control=check_control,
        )

        # Warmup-Ergebnis in stats_json persistieren (fuer Admin-UI / Debugging)
        self._set_warmup_stats(job_id, warmup_result)

        # Cancel-Check ZUERST (warm() kann frueh abgebrochen haben).
        # Warmup/Scan-Phase: Shutdown wird wie Cancel behandelt
        # (kein Verarbeitungs-Fortschritt → Auto-Resume wuerde von vorne beginnen)
        if check_control() in ("cancel", "shutdown"):
            self._finalize_cancelled(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                {
                    "phase": "warmup",
                    "abort_reason": "Abgebrochen waehrend Backend-Warmup",
                    "duration_seconds": int(time.time() - start_time),
                },
            )
            return None

        if not warmup_result.success:
            duration = int(time.time() - start_time)
            failed = [d for d in warmup_result.details if not d["ok"]]
            # Nur Kategorien ohne OK-Backend melden (nicht einzelne Failover-Fehler)
            failed_categories = {d["category"] for d in warmup_result.details} - {
                d["category"] for d in warmup_result.details if d["ok"]
            }
            critical_failed = [d for d in failed if d["category"] in failed_categories]
            error_msg = "Backend-Warmup fehlgeschlagen: " + "; ".join(
                f"{d['category']}({d.get('model') or d['url']}): {d['error']}"
                for d in critical_failed
            )
            self._finalize_error(
                job_id,
                ds_id,
                error_msg,
                duration,
                config=config,
                embedding_model=embedding_model,
                stats={
                    "warmup": {
                        "success": warmup_result.success,
                        "duration_s": warmup_result.duration_s,
                        "details": warmup_result.details,
                    }
                },
            )
            return None

        # Warmup-Stats als Dict fuer run_ingestion() (DDU-Preflight-Skip).
        # Bewusste Dopplung zu _set_warmup_stats(): DB-Persistenz fuer Admin-UI,
        # Parameter-Uebergabe fuer Pipeline (kein zusaetzlicher DB-Read noetig).
        return {
            "success": warmup_result.success,
            "duration_s": warmup_result.duration_s,
            "details": warmup_result.details,
        }

@main.command()
@click.option("--incremental", is_flag=True, help="Only process changed/new files.")
@click.option("--datasource-id", type=int, default=None, help="Index a specific datasource by ID.")
@click.option("--all-datasources", is_flag=True, help="Index all active datasources.")
@click.pass_context
def index(ctx, incremental, datasource_id, all_datasources):
    """Index the knowledge base (full or incremental)."""
    from kiara.ingestion.pipeline import run_all_datasources, run_ingestion

    config = _get_config(ctx)
    # CLI-Policy: Kein --config → persistiert (markieren),
    # explizites --config → kein Marker (Custom-Config-Laeufe)
    if not ctx.obj.get("config_path"):
        config["_kiara_enforce_persisted_colbert_model"] = True
    mode = "incremental" if incremental else "full"

    try:
        if all_datasources:
            click.echo(f"Starting {mode} indexing for all active datasources...")
            click.echo(f"Embedding model: {get_embedding_model(config)}")
            click.echo()

            stats = run_all_datasources(config, incremental=incremental)

            click.echo()
            click.echo("Indexing complete (all datasources):")
            click.echo(f"  Datasources processed: {stats.get('datasources_processed', 0)}")
        elif datasource_id:
            ds_config, row, ds_overrides, hash_mode, path = _prepare_datasource_index(
                config, datasource_id
            )
            click.echo(f"Starting {mode} indexing...")
            click.echo(f"Datasource: {path}")
            click.echo(f"Datasource ID: {datasource_id} ({row['name']})")
            click.echo(f"Embedding model: {get_embedding_model(ds_config)}")
            click.echo()

            stats = run_ingestion(
                ds_config,
                incremental=incremental,
                datasource_id=datasource_id,
                ds_overrides=ds_overrides or None,
                hash_mode=hash_mode,
            )
        else:
            click.echo(f"Starting {mode} indexing...")
            click.echo(f"Datasource: {config['datasource']['path']}")
            click.echo(f"Embedding model: {get_embedding_model(config)}")
            click.echo()

            stats = run_ingestion(config, incremental=incremental)

        click.echo()
        click.echo("Indexing complete:")
        click.echo(f"  Total files found:  {stats['total_files']}")
        click.echo(f"  Files processed:    {stats['processed_files']}")
        click.echo(f"  Files skipped:      {stats['skipped_files']}")
        click.echo(f"  Files deleted:      {stats['deleted_files']}")
        click.echo(f"  Chunks created:     {stats['total_chunks']}")
        click.echo(f"  Errors:             {stats['errors']}")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        click.echo("\nAbgebrochen.")
        sys.exit(130)

def _prepare_datasource_index(
    config: dict, datasource_id: int
) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict, str, str]:
    """Build the effective ingestion config for one DB-backed datasource."""
    import copy

    from kiara.connectors.registry import ensure_loaded
    from kiara.connectors.registry import get as get_connector
    from kiara.ingestion.datasource_runtime import build_datasource_overrides, load_connector_config
    from kiara.repositories.datasource import DatasourceRepository

    ensure_loaded()

    row = DatasourceRepository().get_by_id(datasource_id)
    if not row:
        raise click.ClickException(f"Datenquelle {datasource_id} nicht gefunden.")
    if not row.get("is_active"):
        raise click.ClickException(f"Datenquelle {datasource_id} ({row['name']}) ist deaktiviert.")

    connector_cls = get_connector(row["type"])
    if not connector_cls:
        raise click.ClickException(
            f"Unbekannter Datenquellen-Typ {row['type']!r} fuer ID {datasource_id}."
        )

    ds_config = copy.deepcopy(config)
    conn_config = load_connector_config(row, connector_cls)
    path = connector_cls.safe_prepare_and_scan(conn_config, dict(row), ds_config)
    if path is None:
        raise click.ClickException(f"Datenquelle {datasource_id} ist nicht lesbar.")

    ds_config["datasource"]["path"] = path
    ds_overrides = build_datasource_overrides(row)
    hash_mode = getattr(connector_cls, "HASH_MODE", "mtime")
    return ds_config, row, ds_overrides, hash_mode, path

@_refresh_search_on_exit
def run_ingestion(
    config: dict | None = None,
    incremental: bool = False,
    datasource_id: int | None = None,
    ds_overrides: dict | None = None,
    progress_callback=None,
    control_callback=None,
    embedding_model: str | None = None,
    file_log_callback=None,
    file_start_callback=None,
    resume_skip_files: set[str] | None = None,
    hash_mode: str = "mtime",
    status_callback=None,
    activity_callback=None,
    warmup_stats: dict | None = None,
) -> dict:
    """Run the full ingestion pipeline.

    Args:
        config: Configuration dict. Loaded from default if None.
        incremental: If True, only process changed/new files.
        datasource_id: If set, tag all chunks with this datasource ID.
        ds_overrides: Per-datasource config overrides (chunk_size, chunk_overlap, etc.).
        progress_callback: Optional callback(processed, total) called after each file.
        control_callback: Optional callback() returning "cancel" to abort or None to continue.
            The callback may block internally (e.g. for pause).
        file_start_callback: Optional callback(file_name, file_index, total_files) called
            before each file is processed.
        resume_skip_files: Previous file logs. Only a matching completed hash
            permits skipping; a log alone cannot complete a file.
        status_callback: Optional callback(phase_text) to update job phase in Admin-UI.
            Called with descriptive strings like "Warte auf Backend..." or
            "Verarbeite Dateien...".
        activity_callback: Optional callback(event, **details) fuer direkte
            Datei-/Chunk-/Persistenz-Checkpoints des Worker-Watchdogs.

    Returns:
        Stats dict with counts.
    """
    if config is None:
        config = load_config()
        # Marker: Config stammt aus load_config() — persistiert, re-readbar
        config["_kiara_enforce_persisted_colbert_model"] = True

    # Persistent S4 maintenance blocks a new CLI run before any PG/Qdrant write.
    from kiara.retrieval.elasticsearch_maintenance import assert_access

    assert_access(config)

    # Zentrale Embedding-Modell-Aufloesung (AP4)
    raw_embedding_model = (
        embedding_model
        if embedding_model and embedding_model.strip()
        else get_embedding_model(config)
    )
    embedding_model = normalize_model_name(raw_embedding_model)

    from kiara.ingestion.html_migration import validate_run_selection

    selection = validate_run_selection(config, datasource_id, embedding_model)
    if selection is not None:
        ds_overrides = {**(ds_overrides or {}), "colbert_enabled": False}
    if datasource_id is None or datasource_id == 0:
        datasource_id = _ensure_cli_datasource()
        # Ohne explizite DS wurde bisher kein ColBERT-Aufbau angefordert.
        ds_overrides = {**(ds_overrides or {}), "colbert_enabled": False}

    ctx = _apply_ds_overrides(config, ds_overrides)
    _check_ddu_preflight(ctx, warmup_stats)

    # Backend-Setup
    os.makedirs(config["vectordb"]["path"], exist_ok=True)

    contract_recovery_stats: dict[str, int] = {}
    while True:
        try:
            store = VectorStore(config, embedding_model=embedding_model, intent="write")
            break
        except IndexContractUnavailableError as exc:
            if not control_callback:
                raise
            recovered = _wait_for_index_contract_target_recovery(
                config,
                exc,
                control_callback=control_callback,
                status_callback=status_callback,
                stats=contract_recovery_stats,
            )
            if recovered:
                continue
            cancelled_stats = _init_ingestion_stats([], [], [], {})
            cancelled_stats.update(contract_recovery_stats)
            return cancelled_stats
    chunk_ds = ChunkDatasources()
    batch_size = config["ingestion"]["batch_size"]

    all_files, files_to_process, file_hashes, deleted_files, hash_store, resumed_hashes = (
        _load_and_diff_files(
            config,
            store,
            incremental,
            datasource_id,
            embedding_model,
            resume_skip_files=resume_skip_files,
            hash_mode=hash_mode,
            chunk_ds=chunk_ds,
        )
    )

    from kiara.retrieval.elasticsearch_service import (
        model_uses_elasticsearch,
        refresh_index,
        targets_for_datasources,
    )

    if model_uses_elasticsearch(config, embedding_model):
        # Run durable pending cleanup first; its recorded deletions can explain
        # an empty index. Before any new publication, reject lost live corpus.
        from kiara.ingestion.document_publication import can_replay_unpublished_datasource
        from kiara.retrieval.elasticsearch_indices import DatasourceIndexTarget

        targets = targets_for_datasources(config, [datasource_id], embedding_model)
        if can_replay_unpublished_datasource(
            store, chunk_ds, datasource_id, embedding_model, files_to_process
        ):
            targets = tuple(
                DatasourceIndexTarget(t.datasource_id, t.index_name, 0) for t in targets
            )
        refresh_index(config, targets=targets)

    if resumed_hashes:
        hash_store.upsert_many(datasource_id, embedding_model, resumed_hashes)

    # Hash-Cleanup fuer geloeschte Dateien — file_hashes UND
    # datasource_embeddings-Recount atomar, damit der 4-Schichten-Counter
    # nicht zwischen Mutationen divergiert (auch im CLI-Pfad ohne Worker-
    # Finalize und bei Pipeline-Crash vor _finalize_success).
    if deleted_files:
        from kiara.ingestion.vectordb_ops import _recount_datasource_embeddings

        with db_transaction() as conn:
            hash_store.remove_files(
                datasource_id,
                embedding_model,
                deleted_files,
                conn=conn,
            )
            _recount_datasource_embeddings(conn, datasource_id, embedding_model)

    stats = _init_ingestion_stats(all_files, files_to_process, deleted_files, resumed_hashes)
    stats.update(contract_recovery_stats)
    if stats.get("skipped_files"):
        from kiara.retrieval.elasticsearch_service import (
            mark_search_data_adopted,
            model_uses_elasticsearch,
        )

        if model_uses_elasticsearch(config, embedding_model):
            mark_search_data_adopted(config, [datasource_id])
    if selection is not None:
        stats["html_migration_completed_paths"] = []

    skipped = stats["skipped_files"]
    total = stats["total_files"]

    if progress_callback:
        progress_callback(skipped, total)

    if not files_to_process:
        logger.info("No files to process.")
        # No-Files-Pfad gilt als run_completed=True
        if selection is None and not _run_colbert_model_switch_cleanup(
            config,
            datasource_id,
            chunk_ds,
            embedding_model,
            run_completed=True,
            stats=stats,
        ):
            return stats
        if selection is None:
            hash_store.set_hash_mode(datasource_id, embedding_model, hash_mode)
        # CLI-Pfad: datasource_embeddings aus SoT (chunk_datasources +
        # file_hashes) recounten, damit der 4-Schichten-Counter ohne
        # Worker-Finalize konsistent bleibt. Im Worker-Pfad wird der Wert
        # direkt danach von _finalize_success ueberschrieben.
        if datasource_id is not None:
            from kiara.ingestion.vectordb_ops import _recount_datasource_embeddings

            with db_transaction() as conn:
                _recount_datasource_embeddings(conn, datasource_id, embedding_model)
        return stats

    logger.info("Processing %d files...", len(files_to_process))

    from contextlib import contextmanager

    from kiara.ingestion._file_utils import _LoadedFileVersion

    loaded_versions = {}

    @contextmanager
    def loading_file(path):
        loaded_versions.pop(path, None)
        version = _LoadedFileVersion.capture(path, hash_mode, config)
        yield
        version.validate()
        loaded_versions[path] = version

    def complete_file(path):
        version = loaded_versions[path]
        version.validate()
        completion_options = {"sync_model_sizes": selection is None}
        if _colbert_enabled_for_run(ictx):
            from kiara.retrieval.colbert import colbert_ds_model_key
            from kiara.shared.constants import COLBERT_DEFAULT_MODEL

            current_model = config["retrieval"]["colbert"].get("model", COLBERT_DEFAULT_MODEL)
            completion_options["additional_models"] = (colbert_ds_model_key(current_model),)
        _complete_file(
            hash_store,
            datasource_id,
            embedding_model,
            path,
            version.completion,
            **completion_options,
        )
        if selection is not None:
            stats["html_migration_completed_paths"].append(path)

    def prepare_file(path, metadatas, ids):
        return _prepare_file_chunks(
            config,
            store,
            hash_store,
            chunk_ds,
            datasource_id,
            embedding_model,
            path,
            metadatas,
            ids,
        )

    # Context buendeln
    ictx = _IngestionContext(
        config=config,
        ctx=ctx,
        store=store,
        chunk_ds=chunk_ds,
        hash_store=hash_store,
        batch_size=batch_size,
        datasource_id=datasource_id,
        embedding_model=embedding_model,
        hash_mode=hash_mode,
        ds_overrides=ds_overrides,
        file_hashes=file_hashes,
        stats=stats,
        pending_hashes={},
        file_completion_callback=complete_file,
        file_preparation_callback=prepare_file,
        file_loading_context=loading_file,
        skipped=skipped,
        total=total,
        progress_callback=progress_callback,
        control_callback=control_callback,
        file_log_callback=file_log_callback,
        file_start_callback=file_start_callback,
        status_callback=status_callback,
        activity_callback=activity_callback,
    )

    # run_completed-Tracking: initial True, auf False bei Abort/Cancel
    run_completed = True
    for file_path in tqdm(files_to_process, desc="Loading & chunking"):
        if not _process_file_in_pipeline(ictx, file_path):
            run_completed = False
            break

    _persist_hashes_checkpoint(ictx, force=True)
    if selection is None:
        hash_store.set_hash_mode(datasource_id, embedding_model, hash_mode)

    # ColBERT Model-Switch Cleanup am Ende des Laufs
    if selection is None and not _run_colbert_model_switch_cleanup(
        config,
        datasource_id,
        chunk_ds,
        embedding_model,
        run_completed=run_completed,
        stats=stats,
    ):
        return stats

    # CLI-Pfad: datasource_embeddings aus SoT (chunk_datasources +
    # file_hashes) recounten, damit der 4-Schichten-Counter ohne
    # Worker-Finalize konsistent bleibt. Idempotent — im Worker-Pfad
    # ueberschreibt _finalize_success den Wert direkt danach via
    # _emb_repo.upsert_stats.
    if datasource_id is not None:
        from kiara.ingestion.vectordb_ops import _recount_datasource_embeddings

        with db_transaction() as conn:
            _recount_datasource_embeddings(conn, datasource_id, embedding_model)

    return stats

def run_all_datasources(config: dict | None = None, incremental: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Run ingestion for all active datasources via Connector-Registry.

    Args:
        config: Base configuration dict. Loaded from default if None.
        incremental: If True, only process changed/new files.

    Returns:
        Aggregated stats dict.
    """
    from kiara.connectors.registry import ensure_loaded
    from kiara.connectors.registry import get as get_connector
    from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexCompatibilityError

    ensure_loaded()

    if config is None:
        config = load_config()
        # Marker: Config stammt aus load_config() — persistiert
        config["_kiara_enforce_persisted_colbert_model"] = True

    from kiara.repositories.datasource import DatasourceRepository

    _ds_repo = DatasourceRepository()
    rows = _ds_repo.get_active()

    if not rows:
        logger.info("No active datasources found. Running default ingestion.")
        return run_ingestion(config, incremental=incremental)

    total_stats = {
        "total_files": 0,
        "processed_files": 0,
        "skipped_files": 0,
        "deleted_files": 0,
        "total_chunks": 0,
        "errors": 0,
        "vlm_chunks": 0,
        "vlm_errors": 0,
        "ddu_files": 0,
        "ddu_remote_files": 0,
        "ddu_fallback_files": 0,
        "ddu_remote_errors": 0,
        "ddu_timeout": 0,
        "enrichment_chunks": 0,
        "enrichment_skipped": 0,
        "enrichment_errors": 0,
        "enrichment_time_ms": 0,
        "colbert_chunks_written": 0,
        "colbert_errors": 0,
        "vectordb_errors": 0,
        "vectordb_recoveries": 0,
        "contract_discovery_waits": 0,
        "contract_discovery_recoveries": 0,
        "contract_discovery_wait_seconds": 0,
        "datasources_processed": 0,
    }

    for row in rows:
        ds_config = copy.deepcopy(config)
        ds_type = row["type"]
        ds_id = row["id"]

        connector_cls = get_connector(ds_type)
        if not connector_cls:
            logger.error("Unknown datasource type '%s' for id=%s", ds_type, ds_id)
            total_stats["errors"] += 1
            continue

        hash_mode = getattr(connector_cls, "HASH_MODE", "mtime")

        conn_config = load_connector_config(row, connector_cls)

        path = connector_cls.safe_prepare_and_scan(conn_config, dict(row), ds_config)
        if path is None:
            total_stats["errors"] += 1
            continue

        ds_config["datasource"]["path"] = path
        logger.info("--- Datasource %s: %s (%s) -> %s ---", ds_id, row["name"], ds_type, path)

        ds_overrides = build_datasource_overrides(row)

        try:
            stats = run_ingestion(
                ds_config,
                incremental=incremental,
                datasource_id=ds_id,
                ds_overrides=ds_overrides or None,
                hash_mode=hash_mode,
            )
            for key in (
                "total_files",
                "processed_files",
                "skipped_files",
                "deleted_files",
                "total_chunks",
                "errors",
                "vlm_chunks",
                "vlm_errors",
                "ddu_files",
                "ddu_remote_files",
                "ddu_fallback_files",
                "ddu_remote_errors",
                "ddu_timeout",
                "enrichment_chunks",
                "enrichment_skipped",
                "enrichment_errors",
                "enrichment_time_ms",
                "colbert_chunks_written",
                "colbert_errors",
                "vectordb_errors",
                "vectordb_recoveries",
                "contract_discovery_waits",
                "contract_discovery_recoveries",
                "contract_discovery_wait_seconds",
            ):
                total_stats[key] += stats.get(key, 0)
            if stats.get("colbert_collection"):
                total_stats["colbert_collection"] = stats["colbert_collection"]
            total_stats["datasources_processed"] += 1
        except IndexCompatibilityError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.error("Datasource %s failed: %s", ds_id, exc, exc_info=True)
            total_stats["errors"] += 1

    return total_stats

def _apply_ds_overrides(config, ds_overrides):
    """Wendet Datasource-Overrides auf die Config an und loest Feature-Flags auf.

    Mutiert config in-place (Chunk-Groesse, File-Types, Bild-Extensions).

    Returns:
        ProcessingContext mit aufgeloesten DDU- und VLM-Einstellungen.
    """
    for section, key, override_key in _OVERRIDE_MAPPINGS:
        if ds_overrides and ds_overrides.get(override_key) is not None:
            config[section][key] = ds_overrides[override_key]

    # Attachment-Indexierung: deaktiviert → */attachments/* ausschließen
    if ds_overrides and not ds_overrides.get("index_attachments", True):
        exclude = config["datasource"].get("exclude_patterns", [])
        config["datasource"]["exclude_patterns"] = [*exclude, "*/attachments/*"]

    # Content-Detection: accept_all_text Flag in Config durchreichen
    accept_all = ds_overrides.get("accept_all_text", False) if ds_overrides else False
    if accept_all:
        config["datasource"]["accept_all_text"] = True

    ddu_enabled = ds_overrides.get("ddu_enabled", False) if ds_overrides else False
    ddu_backends = None
    if ddu_enabled:
        from kiara.config import get_ddu_backends

        ddu_backends = get_ddu_backends(config)
        if not ddu_backends:
            ddu_enabled = False
            logger.warning(
                "DDU aktiviert fuer Datasource, aber keine aktiven DDU-Backends "
                "konfiguriert — DDU deaktiviert"
            )

    ddu_ocr_images = ds_overrides.get("ddu_ocr_images", True) if ds_overrides else True

    vlm_enabled = ds_overrides.get("vlm_enabled", False) if ds_overrides else False
    vlm_model = ""
    vlm_url = ""
    if vlm_enabled:
        from kiara.config import get_vlm_backend

        vlm_backend = get_vlm_backend(config)
        if vlm_backend:
            vlm_model = vlm_backend["model"]
            vlm_url = vlm_backend["url"]
        else:
            vlm_enabled = False

    need_images = vlm_enabled or (ddu_enabled and ddu_ocr_images)
    if need_images:
        current_types = set(config["datasource"]["file_types"])
        config["datasource"]["file_types"] = list(current_types | IMAGE_FORMATS)

    vlm_prompt = config.get("ingestion", {}).get("vlm_prompt", "")

    from kiara.config import get_mail_archive_config

    return ProcessingContext(
        mail_archive=get_mail_archive_config(config),
        ddu_enabled=ddu_enabled,
        ddu_backends=ddu_backends,
        ddu_ocr_images=ddu_ocr_images,
        vlm_enabled=vlm_enabled,
        vlm_model=vlm_model,
        vlm_url=vlm_url,
        vlm_prompt=vlm_prompt,
    )
