def _prepare_agent_context(config, data, user, template_content, final_prompt):
    """Bereitet Backend, Retriever, Tools, Adapter und Chain fuer den Agent vor."""
    from kiara.generation.agent_chain import AgentChain
    from kiara.generation.cloud_routing import _resolve_backend_dict
    from kiara.generation.tool_adapter import create_tool_adapter
    from kiara.shared.constants import (
        AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS_CLOUD,
        AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS_OLLAMA,
    )

    allowed_ds, restriction_ds = _build_filter_pair(user, data)

    backend = _resolve_backend_dict(
        config,
        llm_backend_id=data.llm_backend_id,
        filter_datasource_ids=restriction_ds,
    )
    registry = _build_agent_tool_registry(config, data, allowed_ds)

    # Restriction-Levels fuer Agent-Anonymizer ermitteln
    trusted = bool(backend.get("trusted", 0))
    restriction_levels = None
    if _is_cloud_provider(backend) and not trusted:
        from kiara.generation.cloud_routing import _load_restriction_levels

        restriction_levels = _load_restriction_levels(restriction_ds)

    anonymizer = _create_agent_anonymizer(config, backend, restriction_levels=restriction_levels)
    adapter_config = dict(config)
    adapter_config["_kiara_cloud_requires_anonymizer"] = _cloud_requires_agent_anonymizer(
        config,
        backend,
        restriction_levels=restriction_levels,
    )
    adapter = create_tool_adapter(backend, adapter_config, anonymizer)

    if data.num_ctx and hasattr(adapter, "_num_ctx"):
        adapter._num_ctx = data.num_ctx
    if final_prompt and hasattr(adapter, "_final_prompt_override"):
        adapter._final_prompt_override = final_prompt

    max_iter = (
        AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS_CLOUD if _is_cloud_provider(backend) else AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS_OLLAMA
    )

    # Admin-User bekommen Wildcard-Zugriff auf alle Tools
    if user.get("is_admin"):
        user_groups = ["*"]
    elif user.get("group_ids"):
        with db_query() as conn:
            placeholders = ",".join("%s" for _ in user["group_ids"])
            rows = conn.execute(
                f"SELECT cn, dn, name FROM groups WHERE id IN ({placeholders})",
                user["group_ids"],
            ).fetchall()
            user_groups = []
            for row in rows:
                for value in (row["dn"], row["cn"], row["name"]):
                    if value and value not in user_groups:
                        user_groups.append(value)
    else:
        user_groups = []

    chain = AgentChain(
        config,
        registry,
        adapter=adapter,
        user_id=user["id"],
        max_iterations=max_iter,
        max_same_tool_calls=data.max_tool_repeats,
        system_prompt_override=template_content,
        user_groups=user_groups,
    )
    return chain, backend, anonymizer

def _build_agent_tool_registry(config, data, allowed_ds):
    """Erstellt die Tool-Registry fuer den Agent.

    Args:
        config: Globale Config.
        data: QueryRequest (Embedding-Modell, k, Filter).
        allowed_ds: Bereits permission-gefilterte Datasource-IDs oder None.

    Returns:
        ToolRegistry mit allen erlaubten Agent-Tools.

    Raises:
        BackendUnavailableError: Wenn das Embedding-Backend nicht erreichbar ist.
    """
    from kiara.retrieval.reranker import create_reranker
    from kiara.retrieval.retriever import HybridRetriever
    from kiara.tools.builtin_tools import CalculateTool, ListDatasourcesTool, SearchDocumentsTool
    from kiara.tools.document_tools import DocumentReferences, ReadDocumentTool
    from kiara.tools.registry import ToolRegistry, load_config_tool_permissions

    retriever = HybridRetriever(config, embedding_model=data.embedding_model)
    reranker = create_reranker(config)

    registry = ToolRegistry(permission_provider=load_config_tool_permissions)
    references = DocumentReferences(str(retriever._store.get_collection_name()))
    registry.register(
        SearchDocumentsTool(
            retriever,
            reranker,
            config,
            allowed_datasource_ids=allowed_ds,
            default_k=data.k,
            default_filter_type=data.filter_type,
            default_filter_dir=data.filter_dir,
            document_references=references,
        )
    )
    registry.register(ReadDocumentTool(retriever, config, references, allowed_ds))
    registry.register(ListDatasourcesTool(allowed_datasource_ids=allowed_ds))
    registry.register(CalculateTool())

    # ERP-Tools registrieren (falls Feature verfuegbar und Verbindungen konfiguriert)
    tools_cfg = config.get("tools", {})
    if not tools_cfg.get("enabled", False):
        return registry

    from kiara.web.api_health import _get_degradation_manager

    dm = _get_degradation_manager()
    if dm.is_feature_available("erp_tools"):
        try:
            from kiara.tools.erp_backend import ERPBackend
            from kiara.tools.erp_connectors import ConnectionRegistry
            from kiara.tools.erp_tools import (
                ERPCustomerInfoTool,
                ERPOrderStatusTool,
                ERPOrdersTool,
                ERPProductionStatusTool,
                ERPStockLevelTool,
            )

            conn_registry = ConnectionRegistry()
            conn_registry.load_from_config(config)
            backend = ERPBackend(config, connection_registry=conn_registry)

            registry.register(ERPOrderStatusTool(backend))
            registry.register(ERPOrdersTool(backend))
            registry.register(ERPStockLevelTool(backend))
            registry.register(ERPCustomerInfoTool(backend))
            registry.register(ERPProductionStatusTool(backend))
        except Exception as exc:
            logger.warning(
                "ERP-Tools konnten nicht fuer Agent registriert werden: %s",
                exc,
                exc_info=True,
            )

    return registry

@_with_processing_warnings
async def _stream_research(config, data, actual_chat_id, user, history_block=""):
    from kiara.services.research import create_research
    from kiara.shared.processing_warnings import report_processing_warning

    chain = None
    started = time.monotonic()
    yield _sse_event("mode", {"mode": "research"})
    try:
        if data.context_chunks:
            raise ValueError(
                "Recherche benötigt versionierte Originalquellen; Such-Tab-Auszüge bitte abwählen."
            )
        chain = await asyncio.to_thread(
            create_research,
            config,
            user,
            data.question,
            k=data.k,
            num_ctx=data.num_ctx,
            history=history_block,
            backend_id=data.llm_backend_id,
            embedding_model=data.embedding_model,
            selected=data.filter_datasource_ids,
            exclude=data.filter_datasource_exclude,
            filter_dir=data.filter_dir,
            filter_type=data.filter_type,
        )
        async for progress in chain.run():
            yield _sse_event("research_progress", progress)
        result = chain.result
        _save_successful_assistant_message(actual_chat_id, result["answer"], result["sources"])
        _log_query_audit(
            user["id"],
            data.question,
            result["answer"],
            duration_ms=int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
            model_used=result["model"],
            chain_type="research",
            chat_id=actual_chat_id,
            routed_to="local",
            correlation_id=chain.run_id,
            context_sources=json.dumps(result["sources"]),
            request_settings={"research": result},
        )
        yield _sse_event(
            "research_status",
            {
                k: result[k]
                for k in ("run_id", "status", "evidence_status", "coverage", "limitations")
            },
        )
        yield _sse_event("sources", result["sources"])
        yield _sse_event("chunk", {"text": result["answer"]})
    except (asyncio.CancelledError, GeneratorExit):
        if chain:
            chain.cancelled.set()
        report_processing_warning(
            "research", "incomplete", details={"status": "incomplete", "limitations": ["cancelled"]}
        )
        _save_assistant_message(
            actual_chat_id,
            "Recherche abgebrochen. Es liegt keine abschließend geprüfte Antwort vor.",
        )
        raise
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("Recherche-Chat fehlgeschlagen")
        report_processing_warning("research", "failed", details={"status": "failed"})
        message = (
            str(exc)
            if isinstance(exc, ValueError)
            else "Die Recherche konnte nicht durchgeführt werden. Bitte Backend, Quellen und Recherche-Konfiguration prüfen."
        )
        _save_assistant_message(actual_chat_id, message)
        yield _sse_event("error", {"message": message})
    yield _sse_event(
        "done", {"chat_id": actual_chat_id, "research_run_id": chain.run_id if chain else None}
    )

def query_stream(
        self,
        question: str,
        k: int = 5,
        num_ctx: int | None = None,
        filter_dir: str | None = None,
        filter_type: str | None = None,
        filter_datasource_ids: list[int] | None = None,
        history_block: str = "",
        think: bool | None = None,
        context_override: list[dict] | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[Generator[str, None, None], list[dict]]:
        """RAG-Query mit Streaming-Antwort.

        context_override: Vorgefertigte Chunks (z.B. aus Such-Tab),
            ueberspringt Retrieval+Reranking.
        """
        with _tracer.start_as_current_span("rag_query") as span:
            has_datasource_filter = filter_datasource_ids is not None
            self._last_trace_id = get_trace_id_for_span(span)
            span.set_attribute("question", question[:200])
            span.set_attribute("k", k)
            span.set_attribute(
                "has_filter",
                bool(filter_dir or filter_type) or has_datasource_filter,
            )
            span.set_attribute(
                "has_datasource_filter",
                has_datasource_filter,
            )
            span.set_attribute(
                "datasource_filter_count",
                len(filter_datasource_ids or []),
            )
            span.set_attribute("context_override", context_override is not None)

            self._last_prompt = ""
            self._context_warning = None
            self._last_expansions = []
            self._last_retrieval_diagnostics = None
            effective_ctx = num_ctx or DEFAULT_LLM_NUM_CTX

            # 1. Retrieval (oder Context-Override)
            if context_override is not None:
                results = self._retriever.load_context_chunks(
                    context_override, filter_datasource_ids
                )
            else:
                results = self._retrieve_and_rerank(
                    question,
                    k,
                    filter_dir,
                    filter_type,
                    filter_datasource_ids,
                )

            self._last_max_rerank_score = self._max_rerank_score(results)

            if not results:
                self._set_final_context_diagnostics([])

                def empty():
                    yield "Keine relevanten Dokumente gefunden."

                return empty(), []

            # Abstain-Gate nur fuer frisch retrievte Ergebnisse — ein
            # context_override (z.B. Such-Tab) bringt keine kalibrierten Scores.
            if context_override is None:
                abstain = self._abstain_gate(results)
                if abstain is not None:
                    message, abstain_diag = abstain
                    self._set_final_context_diagnostics([])
                    self._annotate_abstain_diagnostics(abstain_diag)
                    span.set_attribute("abstained", True)

                    def abstained():
                        yield message

                    return abstained(), []

            max_chunks = self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get(
                "max_context_chunks", DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT_CHUNKS
            )
            if len(results) > max_chunks:
                from kiara.shared.processing_warnings import report_processing_warning

                report_processing_warning(
                    "context",
                    "chunk_limit",
                    details={"available_chunks": len(results), "included_chunks": max_chunks},
                )
                logger.info("Chunk-Cap: %d -> %d Chunks", len(results), max_chunks)
                results = results[:max_chunks]
            results = self._with_final_context_ranks(results)
            self._retriever.validate_context(results, filter_datasource_ids)
            self._set_final_context_diagnostics(results)

            sources = self._build_sources(results)

            with _tracer.start_as_current_span("context_build") as ctx_span:
                context = format_context(results)
                ctx_span.set_attribute("chunk_count", len(results))
                ctx_span.set_attribute("context_chars", len(context))

            # 2. Prompt bauen
            system_prompt, user_message = self._build_prompt(
                context,
                question,
                history_block,
            )
            joined_prompt = f"{system_prompt}\n\n{user_message}" if system_prompt else user_message
            self._last_prompt = self._expansion_prefix() + joined_prompt
            self._check_context_overflow(joined_prompt, effective_ctx)

            # 3. Backend aufrufen
            # HINWEIS: Dieser Span misst nur die Generator-Erstellung, nicht die
            # tatsaechliche LLM-Inferenz. generate_stream() gibt einen Generator
            # zurueck — die Token-Generierung erfolgt erst beim Konsumieren.
            # Fuer End-to-End-Timing wird die Dauer im query_log erfasst.
            with _tracer.start_as_current_span("llm_setup") as llm_span:
                llm_span.set_attribute("provider", self._backend.provider)
                llm_span.set_attribute("model", getattr(self._backend, "model", ""))
                kwargs = {"think": think}
                if self._backend.provider == "ollama":
                    kwargs["num_ctx"] = effective_ctx

                def generate():
                    # Der Aufrufer kann den Generator erst spaeter konsumieren.
                    # Auch dann muss genau dieser Kontext noch freigegeben sein.
                    self._retriever.validate_context(results, filter_datasource_ids)
                    yield from self._backend.generate_stream(system_prompt, user_message, **kwargs)

                gen = generate()

            span.set_attribute("source_count", len(sources))
            return gen, sources

def _retrieve_and_rerank(
        self,
        question: str,
        k: int,
        filter_dir: str | None,
        filter_type: str | None,
        filter_datasource_ids: list[int] | None,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Optionale Query-Expansion + Retrieval + Reranking + Sibling-Expansion.

        Bei aktivierter Query-Expansion (Config: retrieval.query_expansion)
        werden per LLM alternative Suchbegriffe generiert und fuer jede
        Variante ein separater Retrieve-Aufruf durchgefuehrt. Die Ergebnisse
        werden dedupliziert und per Cross-Encoder auf die besten k Chunks
        reduziert. Bei deaktivierter Expansion ist das Verhalten identisch
        zum bisherigen Single-Query-Ablauf.
        """
        # 1. Query-Expansion (nur mit Reranker sinnvoll — ohne Reranker
        #    werden Expansion-Treffer bei Dedup/Truncation verworfen)
        with _tracer.start_as_current_span("query_expansion") as exp_span:
            variants = self._expander.expand(question) if self._reranker.enabled else [question]
            self._last_expansions = variants
            exp_span.set_attribute("variant_count", len(variants))
            exp_span.set_attribute("enabled", len(variants) > 1)

        # 2. Reranking-Multiplier
        fetch_k = k
        if self._reranker.enabled:
            multiplier = self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get("rerank_fetch_multiplier", 3)
            fetch_k = k * multiplier

        # 3. Multi-Query-Retrieval mit Fehlertoleranz fuer Expansion-Varianten
        all_results: list[dict] = []
        variant_diagnostics: list[dict] = []
        for i, variant in enumerate(variants):
            try:
                results = self._retriever.retrieve(
                    query=variant,
                    k=fetch_k,
                    filter_dir=filter_dir,
                    filter_type=filter_type,
                    filter_datasource_ids=filter_datasource_ids,
                )
                all_results.extend(results)
                diagnostics = self._snapshot_retriever_diagnostics(i + 1, variant)
                if diagnostics is not None:
                    variant_diagnostics.append(diagnostics)
            except Exception as exc:
                from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexCompatibilityError

                if isinstance(exc, (IndexCompatibilityError, RetrievalError)):
                    raise
                diagnostics = self._snapshot_retriever_diagnostics(i + 1, variant)
                if diagnostics is not None:
                    diagnostics["retrieval_error"] = {
                        "type": exc.__class__.__name__,
                        "message": str(exc),
                    }
                    variant_diagnostics.append(diagnostics)
                if i == 0:
                    raise
                report_processing_warning("query_variant")
                logger.warning(
                    "Retrieve fuer Expansion-Variante %r fehlgeschlagen: %s",
                    variant,
                    exc,
                    exc_info=True,
                )
                continue

        # 4. Deduplizierung: Composite-Key aus source + chunk_index + ds_ids
        seen: set[tuple] = set()
        unique_results: list[dict] = []
        for r in all_results:
            meta = r.get("metadata", {})
            ds_ids_raw = meta.get("ds_ids")
            if ds_ids_raw is None:
                ds_ids_norm: tuple = ()
            elif isinstance(ds_ids_raw, (list, tuple, set)):
                ds_ids_norm = tuple(sorted(ds_ids_raw))
            else:
                ds_ids_norm = (ds_ids_raw,)
            key = (meta.get("source", ""), meta.get("chunk_index", -1), ds_ids_norm)
            if key not in seen:
                seen.add(key)
                unique_results.append(r)

        # 5. Reranking immer gegen die ORIGINALFRAGE (nicht gegen Expansion)
        reranked = self._reranker.rerank(question, unique_results, top_k=k)

        # 6. Sibling-Expansion
        if self._reranker.enabled:
            with _tracer.start_as_current_span("sibling_expansion") as sib_span:
                sib_span.set_attribute("input_count", len(reranked))
                reranked = self._expand_sibling_chunks(
                    reranked,
                    unique_results,
                    filter_datasource_ids=filter_datasource_ids,
                )
                sib_span.set_attribute("output_count", len(reranked))

        self._set_chain_retrieval_diagnostics(
            question=question,
            variants=variants,
            variant_diagnostics=variant_diagnostics,
            retrieved_count=len(all_results),
            deduped_count=len(unique_results),
            reranked_count=len(reranked),
        )
        return reranked

def _abstain_gate(self, results: list[dict]) -> tuple[str, dict] | None:
        """Stufe-1-Abstain: Score-Gate auf dem besten Reranker-Score.

        Greift nur bei retrieval.abstain_enabled UND aktivem Reranker — ohne
        Reranking gibt es keinen kalibrierten Relevanz-Score. Ergebnisse ohne
        rerank_score (z.B. Reranker degraded) loesen bewusst KEIN Abstain aus:
        ein kaputter Reranker ist kein Beleg fuer fehlende Evidenz.

        Returns:
            (abstain_message, abstain_diagnostics) oder None (kein Abstain).
        """
        retrieval_cfg = self._config.get("retrieval", {})
        if not retrieval_cfg.get("abstain_enabled", False):
            return None
        if not self._reranker.enabled or not results:
            return None
        try:
            threshold = float(
                retrieval_cfg.get("abstain_min_rerank_score", ABSTAIN_MIN_RERANK_SCORE_DEFAULT)
            )
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            threshold = ABSTAIN_MIN_RERANK_SCORE_DEFAULT
        scores = [
            r.get("rerank_score")
            for r in results
            if isinstance(r.get("rerank_score"), (int, float))
        ]
        if not scores:
            logger.debug("Abstain-Gate uebersprungen: keine rerank_scores vorhanden")
            return None
        max_score = max(scores)
        if max_score >= threshold:
            return None
        message = str(retrieval_cfg.get("abstain_message") or "").strip() or ABSTAIN_MESSAGE_DEFAULT
        diagnostics = {
            "abstained": True,
            "reason": "max_rerank_score_below_threshold",
            "max_rerank_score": round(max_score, 6),
            "threshold": threshold,
            "candidates": len(results),
        }
        logger.info(
            "Abstain-Gate: max_rerank_score %.4f < %.4f (%d Kandidaten) — antworte ohne LLM-Call",
            max_score,
            threshold,
            len(results),
        )
        return message, diagnostics

def query_stream(
        self, question: str, history_block: str = "", think: bool = False
    ) -> Generator[AgentEvent, None, None]:
        """Fuehrt den Agent-Loop aus und yieldet AgentEvents.

        Orchestriert den ReAct-Loop durch Delegation an fokussierte Methoden:
        - _step_with_retry(): LLM-Schritt mit Retry-Logik
        - _filter_tool_calls(): Batch-Dedup + Loop-Detection
        - _handle_loop_abort(): Abbruch bei komplettem Loop
        - _execute_tool_batch(): Parallele/sequentielle Tool-Ausfuehrung
        - _build_executed_results(): Event-Erzeugung + Budget-Truncation
        - _build_loop_skip_events(): Events fuer uebersprungene Calls
        - _handle_forced_search(): Safety-Net fuer lokale Modelle
        - _stream_final_answer(): Finale Antwort-Streaming

        Args:
            question: Die Benutzerfrage.
            history_block: Optionaler Gespraechsverlauf als Prompt-Block.
            think: Wenn True, Thinking aktivieren und <think>-Bloecke
                   in der finalen Antwort durchstreamen.

        Yields:
            AgentEvent-Instanzen fuer jeden Schritt (tool_call, tool_result,
            sources, chunk, error, done).
        """
        with _tracer.start_as_current_span("agent_query") as root_span:
            self._last_trace_id = get_trace_id_for_span(root_span)
            root_span.set_attribute("question", question[:200])
            root_span.set_attribute("max_iterations", self._max_iterations)

            tools = self._tool_registry.list_tools(user_groups=self._user_groups)
            root_span.set_attribute("tool_count", len(tools))
            from kiara.shared.prompt_defense import (
                TAG_HISTORY,
                build_hardened_system_prompt,
                sanitize_with_report,
                wrap_external_data,
            )
            from kiara.shared.prompt_defense_audit import log_defense_event

            if history_block:
                history_report = sanitize_with_report(history_block)
                if history_report.severity != "none":
                    log_defense_event("chat_history", history_report)
                history_block = wrap_external_data(history_report.clean_text, TAG_HISTORY)

            hardened_system_prompt = build_hardened_system_prompt(self._system_prompt)
            self._adapter.init_conversation(
                question,
                hardened_system_prompt,
                tools,
                history_block,
            )
            self._tool_events = []
            if hasattr(self._adapter, "_think"):
                self._adapter._think = think

            all_sources: list[dict] = []
            recent_calls: list[tuple[str, frozenset]] = []
            total_result_chars = 0
            self._retrieval_context_chars = 0
            self._document_read_chars = 0
            self._context_source_numbers = {}
            self._document_context_results = []
            max_same_tool_calls = self._max_same_tool_calls
            total_tool_calls = 0

            for iteration in range(self._max_iterations):
                with _tracer.start_as_current_span("agent_iteration") as iter_span:
                    iter_span.set_attribute("iteration", iteration + 1)

                    # 2. LLM-Schritt
                    with _tracer.start_as_current_span("llm_step") as step_span:
                        step, error_event, retried = self._step_with_retry()
                        step_span.set_attribute("retried", retried)
                    if error_event is not None:
                        root_span.set_attribute("total_iterations", iteration + 1)
                        root_span.set_attribute("total_tool_calls", total_tool_calls)
                        yield error_event
                        yield AgentEvent("done")
                        return

                    if step.tool_call:
                        iter_span.set_attribute("has_tool_call", True)
                        if think and step.text and "<think>" in step.text:
                            import re

                            _think_re = re.compile(r"<think>([\s\S]*?)</think>")
                            for m in _think_re.finditer(step.text):
                                yield AgentEvent("chunk", {"text": f"<think>{m.group(1)}</think>"})

                        all_calls = [(step.tool_call[0], step.tool_call[1], step.tool_use_id)]
                        if step.parallel_calls:
                            all_calls.extend(step.parallel_calls)

                        filt = self._filter_tool_calls(
                            all_calls,
                            recent_calls,
                            max_same_tool_calls,
                        )
                        unique_calls = filt.executable + [
                            (cn, cp, tid, _freeze_params(cp)) for cn, cp, tid in filt.looped
                        ]

                        if filt.looped:
                            with _tracer.start_as_current_span("loop_detection") as loop_span:
                                loop_span.set_attribute("filtered_count", len(filt.looped))

                        if not filt.executable:
                            for event in self._handle_loop_abort(
                                unique_calls, all_calls, iteration
                            ):
                                yield event
                            break

                        # Tool-Ausfuehrung MIT Context-Propagation
                        total_tool_calls += len(filt.executable)
                        executed = self._execute_tool_batch(
                            filt.executable, parent_ctx=get_current_context()
                        )

                        # zip statt next()-Lookup: _execute_tool_batch liefert
                        # die Ergebnisse positionsgleich zu filt.executable zurueck
                        # ([f.result() for f in futures]). Ein name-basierter Lookup
                        # waere bei tid=None (Ollama) nicht eindeutig, wenn mehrere
                        # parallele Calls denselben Tool-Namen tragen.
                        for (cn, _cp, _tid, frozen), (_, _, _, result_for_call) in zip(
                            filt.executable,
                            executed,
                            strict=False,
                        ):
                            if result_for_call is not None:
                                recent_calls.append((cn, frozen))

                        exec_events, batch_results, raw_chunks_map, total_result_chars = (
                            self._build_executed_results(
                                executed,
                                iteration,
                                all_sources,
                                total_result_chars,
                            )
                        )
                        for event in exec_events:
                            yield event

                        loop_events, loop_batch = self._build_loop_skip_events(
                            filt.looped,
                            iteration,
                        )
                        for event in loop_events:
                            yield event
                        batch_results.extend(loop_batch)

                        for dup_name, dup_tid in filt.dup_tids:
                            batch_results.append(
                                (
                                    dup_name,
                                    "Duplikat — bereits im selben Schritt abgehandelt.",
                                    dup_tid,
                                )
                            )

                        if batch_results:
                            self._adapter.add_tool_results(batch_results, raw_chunks_map)
                        continue

                    # 3.5 Forced Initial Search
                    if self._force_initial_search and iteration == 0 and not step.is_final:
                        with _tracer.start_as_current_span("forced_search") as fs_span:
                            forced_events, triggered, total_result_chars = (
                                self._handle_forced_search(
                                    question,
                                    all_sources,
                                    total_result_chars,
                                )
                            )
                            fs_span.set_attribute("triggered", triggered)
                        for event in forced_events:
                            yield event
                        if triggered:
                            total_tool_calls += 1
                            recent_calls.append(
                                ("search_documents", _freeze_params({"query": question}))
                            )
                            continue

                    iter_span.set_attribute("has_tool_call", False)

                # 4. Finale Antwort
                # HINWEIS: final_answer-Span ist BEWUSST vor dem yield from —
                # gleiche Logik wie llm_setup in chain.py. Der Span markiert den
                # Entscheidungspunkt, nicht die Streaming-Dauer.
                with _tracer.start_as_current_span("final_answer") as fa_span:
                    fa_span.set_attribute("source_count", len(all_sources))
                    fa_span.set_attribute("is_cloud_final", step is not None and step.is_final)
                yield from self._stream_final_answer(all_sources, step, think)

                root_span.set_attribute("total_iterations", iteration + 1)
                root_span.set_attribute("total_tool_calls", total_tool_calls)
                return

            # 5. Max-Iterations
            root_span.set_attribute("total_iterations", self._max_iterations)
            root_span.set_attribute("total_tool_calls", total_tool_calls)

            with _tracer.start_as_current_span("final_answer") as fa_span:
                fa_span.set_attribute("source_count", len(all_sources))
                fa_span.set_attribute("is_cloud_final", False)
            yield from self._stream_final_answer(
                all_sources,
                step=None,
                think=think,
                additional_context=(
                    "WICHTIG: Du hast KEINEN Zugriff mehr auf Werkzeuge. "
                    "Verwende KEINEN TOOL_CALL. Beantworte die Frage JETZT "
                    "basierend auf den bisherigen Ergebnissen."
                ),
            )

def _prepare_tool_result(
        self,
        result: dict,
        tool_name: str,
        query: str,
        total_result_chars: int,
        tool_use_id: str | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[str, list[dict], int]:
        """Ein gemeinsamer, bereits budgetierter Inhalt fuer alle Adapter."""
        from functools import lru_cache

        from kiara.generation.adapters.base import PreparedToolText
        from kiara.generation.context_selection import (
            prepare_context,
            prepare_document_read,
            render_context,
        )
        from kiara.shared.prompt_defense import sanitize_with_report
        from kiara.shared.prompt_defense_audit import log_defense_event

        # Kandidaten werden auf der tatsaechlichen Modell-Darstellung gemessen.
        # Wiederholtes Rendern darf keine neuen Pseudonyme fuer denselben Text
        # erzeugen; der Cache lebt nur fuer dieses einzelne Werkzeug-Ergebnis.
        prepare_text = lru_cache(maxsize=128)(self._adapter.prepare_tool_text)

        raw_chunks = result.get("raw_chunks")
        if raw_chunks and tool_name in {"search_documents", "read_document"}:
            cfg = self._config.get("chat", {}).get("agent", {})
            total_budget = max(0, int(cfg.get("context_budget_chars", AGENT_CONTEXT_BUDGET_CHARS)))
            result_budget = max(0, int(cfg.get("context_result_chars", AGENT_CONTEXT_RESULT_CHARS)))
            reserve = min(
                total_budget,
                max(
                    0,
                    int(
                        cfg.get(
                            "context_read_reserve_chars",
                            AGENT_CONTEXT_READ_RESERVE_CHARS,
                        )
                    ),
                ),
            )
            replacements = []
            read_request = result.get("document_read") if tool_name == "read_document" else None
            if read_request:
                reference = read_request["document_id"]
                for previous in self._document_context_results:
                    if previous["tool"] != "search_documents":
                        continue
                    remaining = [
                        c
                        for c in previous["chunks"]
                        if c["metadata"].get("document_ref") != reference
                    ]
                    references = [
                        meta
                        for meta in previous["references"]
                        if meta.get("document_ref") != reference
                    ]
                    if len(remaining) == len(previous["chunks"]) and len(references) == len(
                        previous["references"]
                    ):
                        continue
                    replacement = prepare_text(
                        render_context(remaining, references)
                        if remaining or references
                        else "[Suchauszug durch read_document ersetzt.]"
                    )
                    replacements.append((previous, remaining, references, replacement))
            released = sum(
                len(previous["text"]) - len(text) for previous, _, _, text in replacements
            )
            available = total_budget - self._retrieval_context_chars + released
            if tool_name != "read_document":
                available -= max(0, reserve - self._document_read_chars)
            budget = max(
                0,
                min(
                    result_budget,
                    available,
                    AGENT_TOTAL_RESULT_BUDGET - total_result_chars + released,
                ),
            )
            reranker = None
            if not read_request and cfg.get("final_reranking", True):
                from kiara.retrieval.reranker import create_reranker

                reranker = create_reranker(self._config)
            if read_request:
                context_loader = getattr(raw_chunks, "load_context", None)
                context_chunks = (
                    context_loader()
                    if context_loader is not None
                    and getattr(self._adapter, "requires_document_context", False) is True
                    else None
                )
                prepared = prepare_document_read(
                    raw_chunks,
                    request=read_request,
                    budget=budget,
                    source_numbers=self._context_source_numbers,
                    prepare_text=prepare_text,
                    context_chunks=context_chunks,
                )
                if prepared.chunks:
                    for previous, remaining, references, replacement in replacements:
                        self._adapter.replace_tool_result(
                            previous["text"], replacement, previous["tool_use_id"]
                        )
                        previous.update(text=replacement, chunks=remaining, references=references)
                    self._retrieval_context_chars -= released
                    total_result_chars -= released
                    result["document_read"] = prepared.chunks[0]["metadata"]["document_read"]
                else:
                    result["document_read"] = {**read_request, "budget_exhausted": True}
            else:
                prepared = prepare_context(
                    raw_chunks,
                    budget=budget,
                    query=query,
                    max_sources=max(
                        1,
                        int(
                            self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get(
                                "max_context_chunks",
                                DEFAULT_MAX_CONTEXT_CHUNKS,
                            )
                        ),
                    ),
                    source_diversity=cfg.get("raw_chunk_compaction", True),
                    reranker=reranker,
                    source_numbers=self._context_source_numbers,
                    prepare_text=prepare_text,
                )
            display = prepared.text
            if prepared.truncated:
                from kiara.shared.processing_warnings import report_processing_warning

                report_processing_warning(
                    "context",
                    (
                        "budget_exhausted"
                        if not prepared.chunks
                        else "document_partial"
                        if read_request
                        else "budget_limited"
                    ),
                    details={
                        "tool": tool_name,
                        "budget_chars": budget,
                        "input_chars": prepared.input_chars,
                        "output_chars": len(display),
                    },
                )
            # Statusmeldungen enthalten keine Dokumentbelege. Sie zaehlen zum
            # allgemeinen Werkzeugbudget, ohne die Leserreserve aufzubrauchen.
            self._retrieval_context_chars += len(display)
            if tool_name == "read_document":
                self._document_read_chars += len(display)
            if not display:
                notice = "[Kontextbudget erschoepft; dieses Werkzeug-Ergebnis wurde ausgelassen.]"
                display = PreparedToolText(
                    prepare_text(notice)[: max(0, AGENT_TOTAL_RESULT_BUDGET - total_result_chars)]
                )
            self._document_context_results.append(
                {
                    "tool": tool_name,
                    "text": display,
                    "chunks": prepared.chunks,
                    "references": prepared.references,
                    "tool_use_id": tool_use_id,
                }
            )
            logger.info(
                "Agent-Kontext: tool=%s input_chars=%d output_chars=%d sources=%d "
                "budget=%d truncated=%s",
                tool_name,
                prepared.input_chars,
                len(display),
                len(prepared.chunks),
                budget,
                prepared.truncated,
            )
            return display, prepared.chunks, total_result_chars + len(display)

        display = result.get("result", result.get("error", ""))
        report = sanitize_with_report(display)
        if report.severity != "none":
            log_defense_event("tool_result", report)
        display, total_result_chars = self._truncate_result(
            prepare_text(report.clean_text), total_result_chars
        )
        return PreparedToolText(display), [], total_result_chars

def _stream_final_answer(
        self,
        all_sources: list[dict],
        step: "ToolStep | None",
        think: bool,
        additional_context: str = "",
    ) -> Generator[AgentEvent, None, None]:
        """Streamt die finale Antwort als AgentEvents.

        Zwei Pfade je nach Adapter-Typ:
        - Cloud-Adapter (step.is_final=True): Text ist bereits de-anonymisiert,
          wird als einzelner Chunk yielded.
        - Ollama-Adapter (step ist None oder nicht final): Separater
          stream_final()-Aufruf (Double-Generation-Pattern), yieldet
          Token fuer Token.

        Args:
            all_sources: Gesammelte Quellen aus allen Tool-Calls.
            step: Letzter ToolStep (None beim Post-Loop-/Loop-Abbruch-Pfad).
            think: Wenn True, <think>-Bloecke in der Antwort durchstreamen.
            additional_context: Optionaler Zusatzkontext fuer stream_final()
                                (z.B. "Verwende KEINEN TOOL_CALL" bei Max-Iterations).

        Yields:
            AgentEvent("sources", ...), AgentEvent("chunk", ...), AgentEvent("done").
        """
        if all_sources:
            yield AgentEvent("sources", _deduplicate_sources(all_sources))

        if step is not None and step.is_final:
            # Cloud-Adapter: text ist bereits die de-anonymisierte Antwort
            yield AgentEvent("chunk", {"text": step.text})
        else:
            # Ollama: Separaten Final-Prompt streamen (Double-Generation-Pattern)
            try:
                for chunk in self._adapter.stream_final(
                    additional_context=additional_context, think=think
                ):
                    yield AgentEvent("chunk", {"text": chunk})
            except ToolAdapterError as exc:
                # ToolAdapterError-Texte koennen Backend-Antworten mit
                # Toolparametern/Secrets durchreichen. `exc_info=True` haengt
                # denselben Text ueber den Traceback nochmal an — daher nur
                # redaktierte Klasse+Message loggen.
                logger.error("stream_final fehlgeschlagen: %s", _redacted_exc_repr(exc))
                yield AgentEvent("error", {"message": redact_secrets_in_text(str(exc))})
            except Exception as exc:
                # Unerwartete (nicht-ToolAdapter) Fehler ohne Traceback loggen,
                # weil unbekannte Backend-Antworten ebenfalls Toolparameter
                # tragen koennten. Nutzer erhaelt generischen Text.
                logger.error(
                    "stream_final unerwartet fehlgeschlagen: %s",
                    _redacted_exc_repr(exc),
                )
                yield AgentEvent(
                    "error",
                    {"message": "Finale Antwort konnte nicht erzeugt werden."},
                )

        yield AgentEvent("done")

def _retrieve_and_rerank(
        self,
        query: str,
        k: int,
        params: dict,
        filter_ds_ids: list[int] | None,
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Fuehrt Retrieval mit optionalem Reranking und Sibling-Expansion durch."""
        fetch_k = k
        if self._reranker and self._reranker.enabled:
            multiplier = self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get("rerank_fetch_multiplier", 3)
            fetch_k = k * multiplier

        try:
            results = self._retriever.retrieve(
                query=query,
                k=fetch_k,
                filter_dir=params.get("directory") or self._default_filter_dir,
                filter_type=params.get("file_type") or self._default_filter_type,
                filter_datasource_ids=filter_ds_ids,
                filter_source=self._effective_source_filter(params, query),
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexCompatibilityError

            if isinstance(exc, (IndexCompatibilityError, RetrievalError)):
                raise
            raise RetrievalError(f"Dokumentensuche fehlgeschlagen: {exc}") from exc

        if self._reranker and self._reranker.enabled:
            reranked = self._reranker.rerank(query, results, top_k=k)
            logger.info(
                "search_documents: %d retriever -> %d reranked (top_k=%d)",
                len(results),
                len(reranked),
                k,
            )
            enriched = _enrich_candidates_from_store(
                reranked,
                results,
                self._retriever,
                filter_ds_ids,
                max_document_chunks=self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get(
                    "max_sibling_chunks", self._source_profile["max_sibling_chunks"]
                ),
            )
            from kiara.generation.chain import expand_sibling_chunks

            max_expand = self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get(
                "max_sibling_chunks", self._source_profile["max_sibling_chunks"]
            )
            # Der Agent setzt zusammengehoerige Dokumentteile erst danach
            # zusammen. max_context_chunks begrenzt dort die Quellen; hier
            # wuerde der Cap bereits benoetigte Nachbar-Chunks entfernen.
            results = expand_sibling_chunks(reranked, enriched, max_expand)
            logger.info("search_documents: nach expand_sibling: %d Ergebnisse", len(results))
        else:
            results = results[:k]

        self._retriever.validate_context(results, filter_ds_ids)
        return results

def annotate(self, chunks: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
        from kiara.ingestion.document_publication import assert_documents_published

        assert_documents_published(self._collection, chunks)
        annotated = []
        with self._lock:
            # Erst den gesamten Suchbatch pruefen, bevor Referenzen oder
            # Deduplizierungszustand neue Treffer als uebernommen markieren.
            versions = dict(self._versions)
            for chunk in chunks:
                key = document_key(chunk)
                meta = chunk.get("metadata") or {}
                if meta.get("processing_pending"):
                    raise RetrievalError("Dokumentverarbeitung ist noch nicht abgeschlossen.")
                version = _document_version(meta)
                if key in versions and version != versions[key]:
                    raise RetrievalError(
                        "Dokumentversion wurde veraendert. Bitte eine neue Anfrage starten."
                    )
                if version is not None:
                    versions[key] = version
                    saved = self._references.get(self._reference_id(key, version))
                    known_hash = (
                        saved["chunk_hashes"].get(meta.get("chunk_index")) if saved else None
                    )
                    if known_hash is not None and (
                        not isinstance(chunk.get("text"), str)
                        or hashlib.sha256(chunk["text"].encode()).hexdigest() != known_hash
                    ):
                        raise RetrievalError(
                            "Dokumentversion wurde veraendert. Bitte eine neue Anfrage starten."
                        )
            for chunk in chunks:
                meta = dict(chunk.get("metadata") or {})
                meta.pop("document_ref", None)
                index, total = meta.get("chunk_index"), meta.get("chunk_total")
                version = _document_version(meta)
                if (
                    meta.get("source")
                    and version is not None
                    and type(index) is int
                    and type(total) is int
                    and 0 <= index < total
                ):
                    key = document_key(chunk)
                    reference = self._reference_id(key, version)
                    self._references.setdefault(
                        reference,
                        {"key": key, "metadata": meta, "version": version, "chunk_hashes": {}},
                    )
                    meta["document_ref"] = reference
                annotated.append({**chunk, "metadata": meta})
            self._versions = versions
        return annotated

def search_documents(self, user: dict | None, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        started = time.monotonic()
        correlation_id = str(uuid4())
        self._require_enabled()
        user = self._require_user(user)
        limits = self._limits()
        query = self._required_str(params, "query", max_chars=limits["max_query_length"])
        self._reject_trivial_query(query)
        k = self._int_param(params, "k", 10, min_value=1, max_value=limits["max_k"])
        max_chars = self._int_param(
            params,
            "max_chars_per_result",
            limits["max_chars_per_result"],
            min_value=1,
            max_value=limits["max_chars_per_result"],
        )
        include_text = self._include_text(params)
        selected_ids = self._selected_datasource_ids(params)
        filter_ds_ids = self._allowed_datasource_filter(user, selected_ids)
        file_type = self._optional_str(params, "file_type", max_chars=_FILE_TYPE_MAX_CHARS)
        directory = self._optional_str(params, "directory", max_chars=_FILTER_STRING_MAX_CHARS)
        source_contains = self._optional_str(
            params,
            "source_contains",
            max_chars=_FILTER_STRING_MAX_CHARS,
        )
        source_contains = self._effective_source_filter(source_contains, query)

        retriever = self._retriever()
        reranker = self._reranker()
        fetch_k = k
        if getattr(reranker, "enabled", False):
            multiplier = self._config.get("retrieval", {}).get("rerank_fetch_multiplier", 3)
            fetch_k = k * int(multiplier)

        retrieval_started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            raw_results = retriever.retrieve(
                query=query,
                k=fetch_k,
                filter_dir=directory,
                filter_type=file_type,
                filter_datasource_ids=filter_ds_ids,
                filter_source=source_contains,
            )
        except RetrievalOnlyError:
            raise
        except Exception as exc:
            from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexCompatibilityError

            if isinstance(exc, IndexCompatibilityError):
                raise
            logger.error("Retrieval-only Suche fehlgeschlagen: %s", exc, exc_info=True)
            raise RetrievalOnlyError(
                "retrieval_failed",
                "Retrieval konnte nicht ausgefuehrt werden.",
                503,
            ) from exc
        retrieval_ms = _now_ms(retrieval_started)

        rerank_started = time.monotonic()
        if getattr(reranker, "enabled", False):
            final_results = reranker.rerank(query, raw_results, top_k=k)
        else:
            final_results = raw_results[:k]
        rerank_ms = _now_ms(rerank_started)

        final_results = self._with_final_context_ranks(final_results)
        retrieval_diagnostics = None
        getter = getattr(retriever, "get_last_retrieval_diagnostics", None)
        if callable(getter):
            retrieval_diagnostics = getter()

        results = [
            self._format_result(
                result,
                rank,
                include_text=include_text,
                max_chars=max_chars,
            )
            for rank, result in enumerate(final_results, 1)
        ]

        response = {
            "ok": True,
            "route": "retrieval-only",
            "tool": "search_documents",
            "query": query,
            "results": results,
            **self._content_coverage(
                results,
                available_chunks=len(final_results),
                include_text=include_text,
                scope="selected_search_hits",
            ),
            "diagnostics": self._diagnostics_payload(
                tool="search_documents",
                correlation_id=correlation_id,
                started=started,
                k=k,
                result_count=len(results),
                retrieval_ms=retrieval_ms,
                rerank_ms=rerank_ms,
                retrieval_diagnostics=retrieval_diagnostics,
                max_chars=max_chars,
            ),
            "limits": {
                "max_k": limits["max_k"],
                "max_chars_per_result": limits["max_chars_per_result"],
                "raw_chunks_allowed": self._web_config.get("mcp_retrieval_allow_raw_chunks")
                is True,
            },
        }
        self._audit(user, "search_documents", query, response, results, correlation_id)
        return response

def get_document_context(self, user: dict | None, params: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        started = time.monotonic()
        correlation_id = str(uuid4())
        self._require_enabled()
        user = self._require_user(user)
        limits = self._limits()
        source = self._required_str(params, "source", max_chars=_FILTER_STRING_MAX_CHARS)
        selected_ids = self._selected_datasource_ids(params)
        if not selected_ids:
            raise RetrievalOnlyError("invalid_request", "datasource_id ist erforderlich.", 400)
        datasource_id = selected_ids[0]
        filter_ds_ids = self._allowed_datasource_filter(user, [datasource_id])
        chunk_index = self._int_param(
            params,
            "chunk_index",
            None,
            min_value=0,
            max_value=10_000_000,
        )
        window = self._int_param(
            params,
            "window",
            2,
            min_value=0,
            max_value=limits["max_context_window"],
        )
        max_chunks = self._int_param(
            params,
            "max_chunks",
            limits["max_context_chunks"],
            min_value=1,
            max_value=limits["max_context_chunks"],
        )
        max_chars_total = self._int_param(
            params,
            "max_chars_total",
            limits["max_chars_total"],
            min_value=1,
            max_value=limits["max_chars_total"],
        )
        include_text = self._include_text(params)

        retriever = self._retriever()
        retrieval_started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            chunks = retriever.load_chunks_by_source(source, filter_ds_ids)
        except Exception as exc:
            from kiara.retrieval.index_compatibility import IndexCompatibilityError

            if isinstance(exc, IndexCompatibilityError):
                raise
            logger.error("Retrieval-only Kontext fehlgeschlagen: %s", exc, exc_info=True)
            raise RetrievalOnlyError(
                "retrieval_failed",
                "Dokumentkontext konnte nicht geladen werden.",
                503,
            ) from exc
        retrieval_ms = _now_ms(retrieval_started)

        eligible = []
        for chunk in chunks:
            meta = chunk.get("metadata") if isinstance(chunk.get("metadata"), dict) else {}
            if meta.get("source") != source:
                continue
            if datasource_id not in _normalize_ds_ids(meta.get("ds_ids")):
                continue
            try:
                ci = int(meta.get("chunk_index"))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                continue
            if chunk_index - window <= ci <= chunk_index + window:
                eligible.append(chunk)

        eligible.sort(key=lambda item: int(item.get("metadata", {}).get("chunk_index", 0)))
        available_chunks = len(eligible)
        if len(eligible) > max_chunks:
            eligible = sorted(
                eligible,
                key=lambda item: abs(
                    int(item.get("metadata", {}).get("chunk_index", 0)) - chunk_index
                ),
            )[:max_chunks]
            eligible.sort(key=lambda item: int(item.get("metadata", {}).get("chunk_index", 0)))

        remaining_chars = max_chars_total
        context_chunks = []
        for rank, chunk in enumerate(eligible, 1):
            max_chars = max(1, remaining_chars) if include_text else EXCERPT_LENGTH
            item = self._format_result(
                chunk,
                rank,
                include_text=include_text,
                max_chars=max_chars,
            )
            if include_text:
                used = len(item.get("text", ""))
                remaining_chars -= used
                if remaining_chars <= 0:
                    context_chunks.append(item)
                    break
            context_chunks.append(item)

        response = {
            "ok": True,
            "route": "retrieval-only",
            "tool": "get_document_context",
            "source": source,
            "datasource_id": datasource_id,
            "chunk_index": chunk_index,
            "window": window,
            "context_chunks": context_chunks,
            **self._content_coverage(
                context_chunks,
                available_chunks=available_chunks,
                include_text=include_text,
                scope="requested_document_window",
            ),
            "diagnostics": self._diagnostics_payload(
                tool="get_document_context",
                correlation_id=correlation_id,
                started=started,
                k=max_chunks,
                result_count=len(context_chunks),
                retrieval_ms=retrieval_ms,
                max_chars=EXCERPT_LENGTH,
            ),
            "limits": {
                "max_context_window": limits["max_context_window"],
                "max_context_chunks": limits["max_context_chunks"],
                "max_chars_total": limits["max_chars_total"],
                "raw_chunks_allowed": self._web_config.get("mcp_retrieval_allow_raw_chunks")
                is True,
            },
        }
        self._audit(
            user,
            "get_document_context",
            source,
            response,
            context_chunks,
            correlation_id,
        )
        return response

research_setup.code:
def create_research(
    config,
    user,
    question,
    *,
    k=None,
    num_ctx=None,
    history="",
    backend_id=None,
    embedding_model=None,
    selected=None,
    exclude=False,
    filter_dir=None,
    filter_type=None,
):
    from kiara.generation.backends import create_backend
    from kiara.generation.research_chain import ResearchChain
    from kiara.retrieval.reranker import create_reranker
    from kiara.retrieval.retriever import HybridRetriever
    from kiara.retrieval.source_policy import resolve_chat_sources
    from kiara.tools.builtin_tools import SearchDocumentsTool
    from kiara.tools.document_tools import DocumentReferences, ReadDocumentTool

    settings = research_settings(config)
    if not settings["enabled"]:
        raise ValueError("Recherche ist deaktiviert")
    if not isinstance(question, str) or not question.strip() or len(question) > 10000:
        raise ValueError("Eine Frage mit maximal 10000 Zeichen ist erforderlich")
    if num_ctx is not None and (type(num_ctx) is not int or not 256 <= num_ctx <= 131072):
        raise ValueError("num_ctx muss zwischen 256 und 131072 liegen")
    if selected is not None and (
        not isinstance(selected, list) or any(type(i) is not int or i < 1 for i in selected)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Datenquellen müssen als Liste positiver IDs angegeben werden")
    config, effective_k = resolve_chat_sources(copy.deepcopy(config), "research", k)
    config["retrieval"]["keyword_match_operator"] = settings["keyword_match_operator"]
    config["retrieval"]["keyword_content_only"] = settings["keyword_content_only"]
    config["retrieval"]["elasticsearch_fuzziness"] = settings["keyword_fuzziness"]
    config.setdefault("chat", {}).setdefault("agent", {})["document_read_max_chunks"] = settings[
        "read_chunks"
    ]

    def authorize():
        return refresh_scope(user, selected, exclude)

    allowed = authorize()
    backend = create_backend(config, backend_id)
    # Kein impliziter Cloud- oder Anonymisierungs-Unteraufruf in dieser Stufe.
    if backend.provider != "ollama":
        raise ValueError("Recherche unterstützt in dieser Ausbaustufe lokale Ollama-Backends")
    retriever = HybridRetriever(config, embedding_model=embedding_model)
    refs = DocumentReferences(retriever._store.get_collection_name())
    search = SearchDocumentsTool(
        retriever,
        create_reranker(config),
        config,
        allowed_datasource_ids=allowed,
        default_k=effective_k,
        default_filter_dir=filter_dir,
        default_filter_type=filter_type,
        document_references=refs,
    )
    reader = ReadDocumentTool(retriever, config, refs, allowed)
    return ResearchChain(
        config,
        backend,
        search,
        reader,
        authorize=authorize,
        num_ctx=num_ctx,
        history=history,
        question=question,
    )

async def run_mcp_research(
    user, question, *, k=None, max_chars=20000, backend_id=None, num_ctx=None, selected=None
):
    from kiara.config import load_config
    from kiara.shared.processing_warnings import ProcessingWarnings, processing_warning_scope

    config = load_config()
    if (
        type(max_chars) is not int
        or not 2000 <= max_chars <= research_settings(config)["mcp_max_output_chars"]
    ):
        raise ValueError("Ungueltiges MCP-Ausgabebudget")
    chain = await asyncio.to_thread(
        create_research,
        config,
        user,
        question,
        k=k,
        backend_id=backend_id,
        num_ctx=num_ctx,
        selected=selected,
    )
    warnings = ProcessingWarnings()
    try:
        with processing_warning_scope(warnings):
            async for _ in chain.run():
                pass
    finally:
        if chain.result is not None:
            chain.result["warnings"] = warnings.snapshot()
            await asyncio.to_thread(audit_research, user, chain)
    chain.result["warnings"] = warnings.snapshot()
    research_results.add(chain, user)
    return await research_results.page(chain.run_id, user, max_chars=max_chars)

async def run(self):
        """Fortschritt als Events; das abschliessende result ist fuer Chat und MCP gleich."""
        global _active_runs
        draft = None
        admitted = False
        try:
            with _active_lock:
                if _active_runs >= self.settings["max_active_runs"]:
                    raise ResearchLimit("active_run_limit")
                _active_runs += 1
                admitted = True
            await self._authorize()
            await self._initialize()
            scope = await self._model(_SCOPE, self._question(), "scope")
            entities = scope.get("entities")
            if (
                not isinstance(entities, list)
                or len(entities) > 20
                or any(
                    not isinstance(e, str)
                    or not e.strip()
                    or e.casefold() not in self.question.casefold()
                    for e in entities
                )
            ):
                raise ValueError("Ungueltige Fragezuordnung")
            field = scope.get("field", "")
            if not isinstance(field, str):
                raise ValueError("Ungueltiges Fragefeld")
            # Ein vom Modell versehentlich angehaengtes, explizit benanntes Feld
            # ist kein Eigenname. Wortgrenzen erhalten Namen mit Bindestrichen.
            for label in [field, scope.get("document_kind", "")]:
                if (
                    isinstance(label, str)
                    and label
                    and label.casefold() in self.question.casefold()
                ):
                    entities = [
                        re.sub(r"[-–—]\s*" + re.escape(label) + r"$", "", e, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
                        for e in entities
                    ]
            self.entities = [e for e in entities if e]
            for round_index in range(self.settings["max_rounds"]):
                self._check()
                if len(self.calls) >= self.settings["max_model_calls"] - 2:
                    self._issue("model_call_limit")
                    break
                query = self.question
                if round_index:
                    progress = {
                        "queries": [s["query"] for s in self.searches],
                        "entities": self.entities,
                        "findings": [
                            {"verdict": r["verdict"], "open_question": r.get("open_question", "")}
                            for r in self.reads[-10:]
                        ],
                    }
                    plan = await self._model(
                        _PLAN, self._question() + "\n" + _json(progress), "planner"
                    )
                    query = plan.get("query")
                    if not isinstance(query, str) or not query.strip() or len(query) > 1000:
                        raise ValueError("Ungueltiger Suchplan")
                    # Generische Lockerung: zusammengesetzte Begriffe aufloesen,
                    # bei Wiederholung jeweils nur einen Namen mit dem Feld suchen.
                    # Kein Pfadfilter und keine fach-/anbieterbezogene Ersatzregel.
                    query = re.sub(r"[-–—]", " ", query)
                    if round_index == 1 and self.entities:
                        # Die explizite Kombination der Namen ist ein eigener,
                        # feldunabhaengiger Suchansatz gegen abweichende Labels.
                        query = " ".join(self.entities)
                    if query in [s["query"] for s in self.searches]:
                        alternatives = [f"{entity} {field}".strip() for entity in self.entities]
                        alternatives += self.entities
                        query = next(
                            (
                                q
                                for q in alternatives
                                if q and q not in [s["query"] for s in self.searches]
                            ),
                            "",
                        )
                        if not query:
                            self._issue("repeated_search")
                            break
                yield {"phase": "search", "round": round_index + 1, "run_id": self.run_id}
                # Neue Treffer vor noch offenen alten Fenstern, ohne diese zu verlieren.
                previous = self._pending
                self._pending = deque()
                await self._search_round(query)
                self._pending.extend(previous)
                for _ in range(self.settings["reads_per_round"]):
                    if not self._pending:
                        break
                    if len(self.calls) >= self.settings["max_model_calls"] - 2:
                        self._issue("model_call_limit")
                        break
                    cursor = self._pending.popleft()
                    yield {"phase": "read", "pages_read": len(self.reads), "run_id": self.run_id}
                    await self._read_page(cursor)
            yield {"phase": "verify", "run_id": self.run_id}
            draft = await self._answer()
        except (asyncio.CancelledError, GeneratorExit):
            self.cancelled.set()
            self._issue("cancelled")
            raise
        except ResearchLimit as exc:
            self._issue(str(exc))
        except Exception as exc:
            self._issue("research_error")
            logger.exception("Recherche fehlgeschlagen run=%s: %s", self.run_id, exc)
        finally:
            if admitted:
                with _active_lock:
                    _active_runs -= 1
            coverage = self._coverage()
            if not coverage["complete_within_found_documents"]:
                self._issue("unread_document_ranges")
            if self._pending:
                self._issue("read_limit")
            if any(r["verdict"] == "unclear" for r in self.reads):
                self._issue("uncertain_readings")
            status = "incomplete" if self.issues else "supported" if draft else "not_found_in_scope"
            if not self.searches and self.issues:
                status = "failed"
            answer = (
                draft["answer"]
                if draft
                else "In den geprüften Originalstellen ist keine ausreichend belegte Antwort gefunden worden."
            )
            if status == "failed":
                answer = "Die Recherche konnte nicht durchgeführt werden. Es liegt keine geprüfte Antwort vor."
            if status == "incomplete":
                answer += "\n\nRecherche unvollständig: Weitere Treffer oder Zusammenhänge sind noch ungeprüft; daraus lässt sich kein Fehlen im Datenbestand ableiten."
            ids = list(dict.fromkeys(draft["evidence_ids"])) if draft else []
            sources = []
            for evidence_id in ids:
                evidence = self.store.items[evidence_id]
                sources.append(
                    {
                        "source": evidence["source"],
                        "score": 0,
                        "excerpt": "\n".join(evidence["quotes"]),
                        "quotes": list(evidence["quotes"]),
                        "original_excerpt": evidence["chunk"]["text"],
                        "evidence_id": evidence_id,
                        "document_id": evidence["document_id"],
                        "chunk_ids": evidence["chunk_ids"],
                        "version": evidence["version"],
                        "range": evidence["range"],
                        "spans": evidence["chunk"]["metadata"].get("document_read_spans", []),
                        "verified_original": True,
                    }
                )
            if sources:
                answer += "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(
                    f"[{s['evidence_id']}] {s['source']}\n> " + s["excerpt"].replace("\n", "\n> ")
                    for s in sources
                )
            self.result = {
                "run_id": self.run_id,
                "route": "research",
                "model": self.backend.model,
                "status": status,
                "evidence_status": "supported" if draft else "not_established",
                "answer": answer,
                "sources": sources,
                "evidence_ids": ids,
                "evidence_aliases": self.evidence_aliases,
                "required_entities": self.entities,
                "coverage": coverage,
                "limitations": self.issues,
                "searches": self.searches,
                "results": [
                    {
                        "id": key,
                        "document_id": value["metadata"]["document_ref"],
                        "chunk_id": _chunk_id(value),
                        "source": value["metadata"]["source"],
                        "datasource_ids": value["metadata"].get("ds_ids", []),
                        "chunk_index": value["metadata"].get("chunk_index"),
                        "chunk_total": value["metadata"].get("chunk_total"),
                        "version": self.read._references.resolve(value["metadata"]["document_ref"])[
                            "version"
                        ],
                    }
                    for key, value in self.store.items.items()
                    if key.startswith("R")
                ],
                "reads": self.reads,
                # Ein auslaufender HTTP-Worker darf keine bereits paginierte
                # Antwort nachtraeglich veraendern (Timeout/Abbruch).
                "model_calls": deepcopy(self.calls),
                "resources": {
                    "duration_ms": int((time.monotonic() - self.started) * 1000),
                    "store_peak_bytes": self.store.peak_bytes,
                    "store_accounting": "serialized_utf8_json_without_python_overhead",
                    "storage": "request_ram",
                    "kv_offloading": False,
                    "parallel_inference": 1,
                },
                "budget": asdict(self.budget),
                "token_counting": "estimate_not_exact",
            }
            report_processing_warning(
                "research",
                status,
                details={
                    "run_id": self.run_id,
                    "status": status,
                    "evidence_status": self.result["evidence_status"],
                    "coverage": coverage,
                    "limitations": list(self.issues),
                    "token_counting": "estimate_not_exact",
                },
            )
            logger.info(
                "research_complete run=%s status=%s coverage=%s issues=%s",
                self.run_id,
                status,
                _json(coverage),
                self.issues,
            )

async def _search_round(self, query):
        data = await self._tool(self.search, {"query": query})
        record = {"query": query, "results": [], "returned": len(data["results"])}
        round_documents = set()
        for chunk in data["results"]:
            meta = chunk["metadata"]
            reference = meta.get("document_ref")
            if not reference:
                self._issue("unversioned_result")
                continue
            result_id = (
                "R"
                + hashlib.sha256(
                    _json([reference, _chunk_id(chunk), meta.get("chunk_index")]).encode()
                ).hexdigest()[:20]
            )
            if not self.store.put(result_id, chunk):
                self._issue("store_limit")
                continue
            record["results"].append(result_id)
            # Kleine Quellen ganz; groessere mit Nachbarschaft der Fundstelle.
            start = (
                0
                if meta["chunk_total"] <= self.settings["read_chunks"]
                else max(0, meta["chunk_index"] - 1)
            )
            cursor = (reference, start, 0)
            if (
                cursor not in self._queued
                and reference not in round_documents
                and not self._range_read(reference, start)
            ):
                round_documents.add(reference)
                self._queued.add(cursor)
                self._pending.append(cursor)
        self.searches.append(record)
        logger.info("research_search run=%s data=%s", self.run_id, _json(record))

async def _read_page(self, cursor):
        ref, start, offset = cursor
        params = {
            "document_id": ref,
            "start_chunk": start,
            "start_offset": offset,
            "max_chunks": self.settings["read_chunks"],
        }
        data = await self._tool(self.read, params)
        if len(_json(data["results"]).encode()) > self.settings["store_bytes"]:
            raise ResearchLimit("document_window_store_limit")
        page, user = self._prepare_page(data, self.settings["page_chars"])
        chunk = page.chunks[0]
        reading = chunk["metadata"]["document_read"]
        read_indices = {span["chunk_index"] for span in chunk["metadata"]["document_read_spans"]}
        record = {
            "document_id": ref,
            "source": chunk["metadata"]["source"],
            "range": reading,
            "verdict": "unclear",
            "chunk_ids": [
                _chunk_id(c)
                for c in data["results"]
                if c["metadata"]["chunk_index"] in read_indices
            ],
            "version": self.read._references.resolve(ref)["version"],
        }
        self.reads.append(record)
        try:
            judgement = await self._model(_READ, user, "reader")
            verdict, quotes = judgement.get("verdict"), judgement.get("quotes")
            if (
                verdict not in {"relevant", "unclear", "not_relevant"}
                or not isinstance(quotes, list)
                or len(quotes) > 3
            ):
                raise ValueError("Ungueltiger Leserbefund")
            quotes = [_original_quote(chunk["text"], q) for q in quotes]
            if verdict == "relevant" and not quotes:
                raise ValueError("Positiver Befund ohne Originalzitat")
            if verdict == "relevant" and not self._has_entities(chunk["text"]):
                verdict = "unclear"
                judgement["open_question"] = (
                    "Explizite Zuordnung zur angefragten Person/Organisation fehlt im Originalbereich."
                )
            record["verdict"] = verdict
            record["open_question"] = str(judgement.get("open_question", ""))[:512]
            if verdict == "relevant":
                evidence_id = f"E{len(self.evidence) + 1}"
                evidence = {
                    "id": evidence_id,
                    "document_id": ref,
                    "params": params,
                    "source": chunk["metadata"]["source"],
                    "quotes": quotes,
                    "page": page.text,
                    "chunk": chunk,
                    "range": reading,
                    "chunk_ids": record["chunk_ids"],
                    "version": record["version"],
                }
                if self.store.put(evidence_id, evidence):
                    self.evidence.append(evidence_id)
                    record["evidence_id"] = evidence_id
                else:
                    self._issue("store_limit")
        except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
            self._issue("invalid_reader_output")
        if reading["has_more"]:
            next_cursor = (ref, reading["next_chunk"], reading["next_offset"])
            if next_cursor not in self._queued:
                self._queued.add(next_cursor)
                self._pending.append(next_cursor)
        logger.info("research_read run=%s data=%s", self.run_id, _json(record))
